AI.practical_contributions: 为企业沟通策略、投资者关系管理以及AI辅助语言分析提供了可操作的工具和定量指导，帮助企业在信息披露中寻找最优语言清晰度水平。

title: A Functional Approach to Fixed-Income P&L Attribution

detail.title: A Functional Approach to Fixed-Income P&L Attribution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Standard fixed-income P&L attribution produces systematic residuals that undermine financial reporting and trigger capital surcharges under the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) P&L Attribution test. We propose the Functional P&L Attribution (FPLA) framework, built on the Exact Smooth Term Structure Estimation (ESTE), to reduce these residuals. Using the smooth, exact-fitting curve that ESTE provides, we derive closed-form first-and second-order sensitivity formulas requiring no numerical bumping. The resulting P&L identity decomposes realized gains into carry, roll-down, delta, and a second-order covariance term that arises because the curve construction itself depends on the prevailing quoted rates-a term structurally absent from key-rate methods and non-zero even for deterministic cash-flow portfolios. In the absence of model inconsistency and numerical error, the decomposition yields an exact discrete-time P&L identity with no residual for linear portfolios. Both first-order sensitivity and second-order gamma are available analytically from the daily curve build, with no additional computation. Empirical tests on EUR and USD swap data confirm FPLA materially reduces attribution residuals and improves FRTB green-zone frequencies. The multi-curve extension is developed in a self-contained appendix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于精确平滑期限结构估计（ESTE）的功能性损益归因（FPLA）框架，通过解析敏感性公式消除标准固定收益损益归因中的系统性残差，并改善FRTB损益归因测试中的绿区频率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过改进损益归因框架来消除标准固定收益损益归因中的系统性残差，并提升FRTB损益归因测试的通过率？
AI.motivation: 标准固定收益损益归因会产生系统性残差，这些残差不仅损害财务报告质量，还会在FRTB的损益归因测试中触发资本附加费（capital surcharges）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于精确平滑期限结构估计（ESTE）的功能性损益归因（FPLA）框架，利用闭合形式的敏感度公式进行损益分解。
AI.method: 构建ESTE曲线，推导一阶和二阶解析敏感度公式（无需数值bumping），将已实现损益分解为carry、roll-down、delta和二阶协方差项；并通过EUR和USD互换数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: FPLA在无模型不一致和数值误差的情况下，对线性组合产生无残差的精确离散时间损益恒等式；实证表明FPLA显著减少了归因残差并提高了FRTB绿区频率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了曲线构建本身依赖于现行报价利率这一被关键利率方法结构性忽视的二阶协方差项；提供了无需数值bumping的解析敏感性推导方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易台提供准确的财务报告工具，降低FRTB损益归因测试下的资本附加费负担；解析公式可直接从每日曲线构建中获得，无需额外计算成本。

title: Sustainable Municipal Finance for Suthra Punjab: A Comparative Study of the Excise & Taxation Department and Municipal Committees

detail.title: Sustainable Municipal Finance for Suthra Punjab: A Comparative Study of the Excise & Taxation Department and Municipal Committees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial conflict of interest. The author is a serving officer of the Provincial Management Service of Punjab and has previously served in the Excise & Taxation Department and as Administrator of Municipal Committees — the institutions examined in this study. This professional experience informed the research design and provided access to the administrative context, but the author has no financial or personal interest in the outcome of the proposed reform. The research received no funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit body, and no institution reviewed or approved the manuscript prior to submission.

publicationDetails.detailsText: The paper has been accepted to appear in Pakistan Journal of Social Sciences BZU Multan.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a strategic financial model for a systematic imposition and collection of the Suthra Punjab Fee (SWMF) through use of database prepared by the Excise & Taxation Department Punjab in respect of the potential residential and non-residential taxpayers for urban immoveable property tax (UIPT). Further, the proposed model envisages a legal framework for merger of the two taxes as a single consolidated Property Tax, to be levied and collected by the E&TD under cover of the PLGA 2022 & UIPT Act 1958 through a single demand notice supported by unified coercive regime. Dilating on primary data, gleaned from Municipal Committees & E&TD across Punjab, the paper builds its argument upon a detailed comparative analysis of respective collection performance under the MCs & E&TD in behalf of the two levies, which are duly assessed and notified under the same schedule of the PLGA 2022. The paper argues that the observed performance gap is attributable to institutional design instead of legal asymmetry since the two agencies possess at-least equivalent enforcement powers. The paper also highlights structural weaknesses of the LGs as revenue collecting agency using case study of the MC Sadiqabad and interestingly confirms this institutional disparity as systemic through expansion of the comparison across multiple urban rating areas in Punjab. Additionally, the author proposes an extension of the model to the rural areas on the plea that the Suthra Punjab delivers the rural areas the same civic amenities, which were earlier unavailable to rural residents. This creates justification for inclusion of rural areas into rating area framework. The study makes the case that the Suthra Punjab Program's long-term financial viability depends on the consistent recovery of the consolidated Property Tax, which cannot be accomplished without the E&T Department serving as the main collecting agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个战略性财税模型，用于系统地征收旁遮普省"清洁旁遮普费"（SWMF），利用旁遮普省消费税与税务部门（E&TD）已有的城市不动产税（UIPT）数据库。模型还设想一个法律框架，将两种税合并为单一的综合财产税，由E&TD依据PLGA 2022和UIPT Act 1958通过单一缴款通知和统一强制征收机制来实施。通过对旁遮普省市政委员会（MCs）与E&TD的原始数据比较分析，论文论证了两机构在法律权力相当的情况下，征收绩效差距源于制度设计问题而非法律不对称。论文还通过MC Sadiqabad案例研究揭示地方政府作为税收征收机构的制度性弱点，并扩展到多个城市评估区以确认该差距具有系统性。此外，作者提议将模型扩展到农村地区。研究认为"清洁旁遮普计划"的长期财务可持续性依赖于综合财产税的持续征收，而这离不开E&TD作为主要征收机构。
AI.research_question: 如何通过制度设计改进实现旁遮普省清洁费（SWMF）与城市不动产税（UIPT）的系统性合并征收，并确保"清洁旁遮普计划"的长期财务可持续性？
AI.motivation: 旁遮普省"清洁旁遮普计划"面临征收效率低下的问题，地方政府（LGs）作为征收机构绩效不佳，而消费税与税务部门（E&TD）在同类税种征收中表现更好。论文旨在通过机构整合和制度设计来提升税收征收效率，并探讨将合并后的财产税扩展到农村地区的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义与地方政府税收征收的制度设计理论；税收征管的机构能力与制度激励理论；公共财政中的合并税制与统一征收框架理论。
AI.method: 以旁遮普省市政委员会与E&TD的原始一手数据为基础，对两个机构在两类税收上的征收绩效进行详细的比较分析；采用MC Sadiqabad案例研究揭示地方政府结构性弱点，并将比较扩展至旁遮普省多个城市评估区以确认制度差距的系统性。
AI.findings: 1) E&TD在征收绩效上显著优于地方政府，绩效差距源于机构设计而非法律权力不对称；2) 地方政府作为征收机构存在结构性弱点，且该问题具有系统性；3) 将两种税合并为综合财产税由E&TD征收是提升效率和保障计划财务可持续性的关键路径；4) 农村地区由于获得相同市政服务，应被纳入评估区框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为发展中国家的地方税制合并与征收机构整合提供了实证案例和理论框架；2) 揭示了在法律权力对等条件下，机构制度设计差异如何导致征收绩效差距，深化了税收征管制度理论；3) 将"服务-征税对等"原则应用于农村税基扩展的论证，丰富了财税联邦理论中关于税收管辖权与公共服务对等性的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为旁遮普省"清洁旁遮普计划"提供了可操作的综合财产税合并征收模型；2) 建议由E&TD作为主要征收机构以提升征收效率，为政策制定者提供明确改革方向；3) 提出将市政税扩展到农村地区的具体方案，拓展税基并保障计划的长期财务可持续性；4) 通过统一缴款通知和强制征收制度简化纳税流程，降低征收成本。

title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Management, Centre for Monetary and Financial Studies (CEMFI), Yale University, Banco de España and Northwestern University

detail.title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract:
Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents’ partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个存在模糊归因条件下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过原创调查和调查实验验证其预测。研究发现，当政府责任归属不明确时，选民会根据党派偏好进行理性归因：对公共医疗评价好的选民将功劳归于自己偏好政党执政的政府层级，评价差的选民则将责任推给不喜欢的政党执政的层级。当同一政党同时掌控中央和地方政府时，这种党派性归因模式消失。模型和实证结果表明，在归因模糊的情况下，党派先验信念极难被撼动。
AI.research_question: 在政府责任归属模糊的情况下，选民的党派性归因（如归功与归咎的不同模式）是否可以通过理性的贝叶斯更新过程来解释，而非仅仅源于动机性推理或党派偏见？
AI.motivation: 责任清晰度是政治问责制的核心要素，但现有文献常将选民的党派性归因解释为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据。作者希望论证在归因模糊条件下，理性的贝叶斯更新本身就能产生这种党派性归因模式，从而提供一种替代性（且更简约）的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯更新理论（Bayesian updating）；归因模糊性（ambiguous attribution）；理性选择理论；责任归属理论（clarity of responsibility）
AI.method: 理论建模（理性贝叶斯更新模型）＋原创调查问卷（测量党派立场、公共医疗质量评估、政府层级责任信念）＋调查实验（向被试提供官方医疗质量信息，观察其信念更新方向）
AI.findings: （1）选民对公共医疗质量的评估与归因呈现党派性模式：好的评估归功于偏好政党执政的层级，差的评估归咎于不喜欢的政党执政的层级；（2）当同一政党同时掌控中央和地方政府时，党派性归因模式消失；（3）提供官方质量信息的调查实验中，被试按预测的党派方向更新信念；（4）在归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被更新或动摇。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）为党派性归因现象提供了理性贝叶斯更新的理论解释，挑战了将其简单归因为动机性推理或党派偏差的既有观点；（2）揭示了归因模糊性与党派先验顽固性之间的理论机制，深化了对政治问责制下信息处理过程的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对政策制定者和政府机构而言，提供明确、清晰的责任归属信息有助于降低党派性归因偏差，提升政府问责效率；（2）研究揭示在归因模糊环境中单纯提供事实信息（如官方质量评估）难以有效纠正选民信念，提示治理者需关注责任分配的清晰化设计。

title: On the Rationality of Bundled Rebate Program in Modem Chip Industry: an Analysis on Qualcomm's Case
affiliations: Fudan University and National Sun Yat-Sen University

detail.title: On the Rationality of Bundled Rebate Program in Modem Chip Industry: an Analysis on Qualcomm's Case
detail.abstract: This paper examines the motivations of a patent holder, for example, Qualcomm holding many standard essential patents (SEPs) on modem chips, to implement a bundled rebate program for its customers, Apple for instance, under the risk of violating antitrust law. This study originates from the lawsuit between Qualcomm, Federal Trade Commission (FTC), and Apple. In early 2017, both FTC and Qualcomm's customer, Apple, sued Qualcomm for violating antitrust law. Qualcomm was alleged to have manipulated "web of contracts" by implementing so-called no license, no chips policy to achieve its anticompetitive purpose. By addressing the case law of antitrust regime related to bundled rebate and loyalty discount, we understand legal risks that Qualcomm might face. Moreover, in this paper, we build a gametheoretical model to explore business reasons why Qualcomm insists on implementing the bundled rebate and loyalty discount program, regardless of latent legal risks. It is shown that Qualcomm might desire to mitigate future loss from price war with potential competitors. Finally, this article concludes with expectations for future studies on the impact of the Federal Court if SEPs and modem chips cannot be bundled together.

AI.tldr: 本文以高通与FTC、苹果之间的反垄断诉讼为背景，研究标准必要专利持有者（如高通）在面临反垄断法律风险下，仍坚持实施捆绑回扣和忠诚折扣计划的商业动机。通过构建博弈论模型，揭示高通可能希望通过该计划缓解未来与潜在竞争对手的价格战损失。
AI.research_question: 专利持有者（如高通）为何在面临反垄断法律风险的情况下，仍坚持实施捆绑回扣和忠诚折扣计划？其背后的商业动机是什么？
AI.motivation: 该研究源于2017年高通与FTC及苹果之间的反垄断诉讼。高通被指控通过"无许可、无芯片"政策实施反竞争行为，因此需要深入理解其商业动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法案例法（涉及捆绑回扣和忠诚折扣）、博弈论
AI.method: 结合反垄断法案例分析（法律审查）与博弈论模型构建
AI.findings: 高通坚持实施捆绑回扣和忠诚折扣计划的动机在于缓解未来与潜在竞争对手之间价格战可能带来的损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解标准必要专利持有者在反垄断约束下的捆绑定价行为提供了博弈论分析框架，补充了反垄断法与商业策略交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构评估SEP持有者捆绑行为的合法性提供参考；同时为行业内参与者理解专利持有者定价策略提供洞见。

title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
affiliations: London School of Economics, , London School of Economics, University of California, Berkeley and London School of Economics

detail.title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
detail.abstract:
Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how — and when — institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive — 11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019 — while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s — a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的实证方法来实时检测关键节点（critical junctures），其核心洞见是将关键节点理解为制度不确定性时期，并利用大语言模型对《泰晤士报》1800-2019年间1195万篇文章进行分类，构建了首个基于文本的长期制度不确定性指数，能够捕捉到被其他风险指数遗漏的制度转型关键时刻。
AI.research_question: 如何在制度变革发生时（而非事后）检测关键节点？如何构建一个基于实时话语的制度不确定性测量指标？
AI.motivation: 大多数关键节点的实证研究仅从事后回顾的角度展开，因此可能遗漏那些制度处于波动状态但最终未发生变革的关键时刻，导致对制度变迁何时以及如何发生的理解存在偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键节点理论（Critical Junctures Theory）：制度变迁往往发生在多个制度未来并存的关键时刻，包括回归现状的可能；制度不确定性是识别关键节点的核心特征。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型的文本分类器，应用于《泰晤士报》档案（1800-2019年，共1195万篇文章），重点分析1900-2019年120年的报道，构建长期制度不确定性指数。
AI.findings: （1）该指数能捕捉正式制度未变革但与关键节点定义一致的高不确定性时期；（2）能对世界大战等重大全球动荡提供更早的信号；（3）以统一的事前测量标准评估候选关键节点；（4）当前美国和英国的制度不确定性与20世纪40年代初相当，其他主流风险测量指标均未捕捉到此信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 为关键节点理论提供了首个基于文本的长期测量工具，推动关键节点研究从回顾性分析转向实时（ex ante）分析，使研究者能够识别那些最终未导致制度变革但仍处于制度转折点的事件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了一个新的制度不确定性和风险监测工具，能够更早识别制度转型的预警信号，弥补了现有地缘政治和经济风险指数的不足。

title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
detail.abstract:
Consider a referee report containing the sentence: “Assignment to treatment was voluntary, though the authors acknowledge this as a limitation in the conclusion.” The Editor would summarily reject. Now replace “assignment to treatment” with “entry into the experimental sample,” and the sentence describes the modal published experiment. This study shows that both biases are the same mathematical object. The bias from non-random sample entry is the sorting-on-gains term from the classic selection decomposition. Interestingly, they both admit an isomorphic Roy micro-foundation and inverse-Mills characterization. A simple calibration reveals that for the typical experiment, the observed bias can be large. One solution to this bias is to conduct a natural field experiment (NFE). When an NFE is not possible, three alternative reporting practices are offered.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文指出随机实验中的"实验样本非随机进入"偏差与经典的"选择性处理分配"偏差在数学上是同一对象，且具有同构的Roy微观基础和逆Mills特征刻画。校准分析显示该偏差在典型实验中可能很大，并提出自然田野实验（NFE）及三种替代报告实践作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 实验样本进入的非随机性（voluntary entry into experimental sample）所产生的偏差，是否与处理分配非随机性（non-random assignment to treatment）所产生的经典选择性偏差在数学结构上等价？
AI.motivation: 审稿人对"处理分配是自愿的"这一限制几乎会立即拒绝，但对"样本进入是自愿的"却普遍接受。作者试图揭示这两种看似不同的问题在数学上是同一偏差，从而呼吁学术界将样本选择纳入审稿标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典选择分解（sorting-on-gains）；Roy模型微观基础；逆Mills比率特征化
AI.method: 理论推导证明两类偏差的数学等价性；使用校准分析方法估计典型实验中该偏差的规模
AI.findings: 1. 非随机样本进入偏差与选择性处理分配偏差是同一数学对象；2. 两者具有同构的Roy微观基础和逆Mills表征；3. 校准表明典型实验中该偏差可能相当大；4. 自然田野实验可作为解决方案，另提出三种替代报告实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了实验外部效度（样本选择）与内部效度（处理分配）两类偏差的理论框架，揭示其数学同构性，为实验选择的建模提供了统一视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实验研究者提供可操作的偏差解决方案（NFE及三种替代报告方式），并为期刊审稿人提供了评估样本选择偏差的新标准。

title: Designing Around Selection: Identification and Inference Under Multi-Dimensional Unobserved Heterogeneity
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School, University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Lyft, Inc. and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: Designing Around Selection: Identification and Inference Under Multi-Dimensional Unobserved Heterogeneity
detail.abstract:
We study identification and optimal policy design in a broad class of principal-agent models. We show that the most common empirical framework within the literature is equivalent to an unstructured potential-outcomes model augmented with three specific assumptions: the Law of Demand (LoD), or treatment-effect monotonicity; extrapolative model structure (EMS), which rules out lumpy agent responses to price changes; and rank invariance (RI), which restricts unobserved heterogeneity (UH) to be one-dimensional. This decomposition isolates the identifying content of each assumption and clarifies its economic role. The LoD and MS are empirically testable using exogenous price variation; RI, on the other hand, is a strong assumption ruling out many economically plausible behaviors, and also not empirically testable. We derive sharp bounds on counterfactual outcomes when RI is relaxed. The conventional 1-dimensional model delivers an upper bound on planner objectives, while the lower bound, which allows for arbitrary multi-dimensional UH, has an adversarial interpretation for policy design. We estimate empirical bounds and apply them to nonlinear pricing of rideshare services. The resulting robust pricing policy fully insures against worst-case latent selection while preserving most of the profit and consumer-surplus gains predicted by the conventional model. Our framework provides a tractable approach to robust policy design in adverse-selection settings including Mirrleesian taxation, regulation, labor supply, and procurement.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类广泛的主代理模型中的识别与最优政策设计问题。作者将文献中最常见的实证框架分解为三个具体假设：需求定律（LoD）、外推模型结构（EMS）和秩不变性（RI）。通过这一分解，文章隔离了每个假设的识别内容和经济作用，并在放宽RI假设时推导出反事实结果的锐界。作者将这一框架应用于网约车服务的非线性定价，提出了对最坏情况潜在选择具有完全保险作用的稳健定价政策。
AI.research_question: 在主代理模型中，常见的实证识别假设各自承担什么经济角色？当放松秩不变性假设时，如何推导反事实结果的边界，并设计稳健的最优政策？
AI.motivation: 主代理模型文献中最常见的实证框架隐含了多个强假设，但这些假设的识别内容和经济含义缺乏明确的分解。特别是秩不变性（RI）假设限制未观测异质性为一维，排除了许多经济上合理的行为，但该假设不可检验。作者希望厘清这一框架的结构，并为政策设计提供更稳健的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在结果模型；主代理理论；需求定律（LoD）；外推模型结构（EMS）；秩不变性（RI）；部分识别理论；稳健政策设计
AI.method: 将实证框架等价转化为无结构的潜在结果模型加上三个特定假设；利用外生价格变动对LoD和EMS进行实证检验；在放松RI时推导反事实结果的锐界（sharp bounds）；利用上下界分别对应传统一维模型和允许多维未观测异质性的对抗性解释；将方法应用于网约车服务的非线性定价并进行实证估计。
AI.findings: 传统的一维模型为规划者目标提供了上界；允许任意多维未观测异质性的下界对政策设计具有对抗性解释。在网约车非线性定价应用中，稳健定价政策能完全保险最坏情况下的潜在选择，同时保留传统模型预测的大部分利润和消费者剩余收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将主代理模型中最常见的实证框架分解为三个可分离的假设（LoD、EMS、RI），明确隔离了各自的识别内容和经济角色；证明LoD和EMS可检验而RI不可检验；在放松RI时提供了反事实结果的锐界；建立了从部分识别到稳健政策设计的系统框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网约车等平台经济的非线性定价提供了稳健政策设计方法；框架可应用于Mirrlees式税收、监管、劳动力供给和采购等逆选择场景，为政策制定者在不依赖强不可检验假设的情况下设计政策提供了可操作的工具。

title: Distributional Deep Learning for Flood Risk under Compound Climate Events: An Application to Index Insurance
affiliations: and University of Wisconsin - Madison

detail.title: Distributional Deep Learning for Flood Risk under Compound Climate Events: An Application to Index Insurance
detail.abstract:
Catastrophic flood events are increasingly driven by compound climate processes, where interactions across atmospheric, hydrological, and geographic systems generate complex and spatially structured loss patterns. These features pose challenges for property-level loss modeling and limit the effectiveness of traditional risk management approaches. We develop a hierarchical distributional deep learning framework that captures temporal evolution of weather conditions, spatial structure induced by geographic proximity and hydrological connectivity, and heterogeneous exposure characteristics. The model integrates sequence-based representations, graph-based spatial learning, and permutation-invariant aggregation of property-level features, and parameterizes the full conditional loss distribution using a generalized gamma family. 

Using data from named flood events under the National Flood Insurance Program, we show that the proposed approach improves predictive performance at both the property and portfolio levels relative to existing methods, including under forward-looking evaluation. Beyond prediction, we demonstrate the value of distributional modeling through an application to index insurance design for catastrophic risk management. These findings illustrate how improved modeling of losses arising from compound climate events can support more effective and responsive risk mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个层次化分布深度学习框架，用于捕捉复合气候事件引发的巨灾洪水损失建模。该框架整合了基于序列的时序表征、基于图的空间学习和置换不变的财产特征聚合，并使用广义伽马族参数化完整的条件损失分布。基于国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的命名洪水事件数据，该方法在财产和投资组合层面均优于现有方法，并通过指数保险设计的应用展示了分布建模的实用价值。
AI.research_question: 如何建立能够捕捉复合气候过程（大气、水文、地理系统交互作用）引发的、具有复杂空间结构的洪水损失模型，以提升财产级损失预测的准确性并支持巨灾风险管理决策？
AI.motivation: 复合气候过程驱动的巨灾洪水事件日益增多，其跨系统交互产生复杂且空间结构化的损失模式。这些特征对传统的财产级损失建模构成挑战，制约了传统风险管理方法的有效性，因此需要更先进的建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复合气候过程理论；层次化分布建模；深度学习（序列表示、图神经网络、置换不变聚合）；广义伽马分布族
AI.method: 构建层次化分布深度学习框架，整合三类组件：1）序列模型捕捉天气条件的时间演化；2）图神经网络捕捉地理邻近性和水文连通性带来的空间结构；3）置换不变的聚合函数处理异质性财产特征。模型使用广义伽马分布族参数化完整条件损失分布。数据来源为国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的命名洪水事件，并进行前瞻性评估。
AI.findings: 在财产层面和投资组合层面，所提出的方法在预测性能上均优于现有方法，包括在前瞻性评估情境下也表现优异。此外，通过将分布建模应用于指数保险设计，展示了其对巨灾风险管理的额外价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种层次化分布深度学习框架，将时序、空间和财产特征聚合整合于统一的损失分布建模中，推动了复合气候事件损失建模的理论与方法发展；为巨灾风险中分布建模（而非仅点预测）的理论价值提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司和风险管理机构提供了更准确的财产级和组合级洪水损失预测工具；通过指数保险设计应用，展示了该框架在巨灾风险管理中的实际落地价值，有助于制定更有效和响应更灵敏的风险缓解策略。

title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
detail.abstract:
We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a "market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备帮助中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任制度下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性对降低冻结风险的作用。作者提出了一个"市场最后支持原则"（market-backstop principle），类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则，将或有国家买家最后干预（恢复交易）与适度的流动性要求（限制道德风险）相结合。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。文章还探讨了对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的启示。
AI.research_question: 当二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性应如何设计以恢复市场功能并平衡道德风险？
AI.motivation: 现有文献关注巴杰特原则下央行对银行的最后贷款人角色，但忽视了在二级市场冻结情境下，央行如何通过储备管理与"最后买家"干预来恢复市场流动性的问题。自由放任下中介机构储备不足，存在市场失灵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性挤兑理论、市场冻结与二级市场失灵理论、巴杰特原则的拓展（从最后贷款人到最后买家）、中介机构储备与流动性管理的一般均衡模型。
AI.method: 理论建模（一般均衡模型），分析自由放任均衡下中介机构的储备决策，以及引入"市场最后支持原则"（或有干预+流动性要求）后的福利效果比较。
AI.findings: （1）自由放任下中介机构持有的央行储备不足，忽视了总体流动性对降低市场冻结风险的溢出效应；（2）"市场最后支持原则"——将或有状态的最后买家干预与温和的流动性要求结合——能够恢复市场功能同时限制道德风险；（3）恢复市场运作的福利收益超过干预的财政成本；（4）该原则对中央银行资产负债表的规模和构成具有重要政策含义。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将巴杰特原则从银行部门（最后贷款人）拓展至二级市场流动性（最后买家），提出"市场最后支持原则"；（2）揭示了中介机构储备持有的集体行动问题（总体流动性外部性）；（3）在理论层面阐明了干预政策与审慎监管（流动性要求）的最优组合设计。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为中央银行的二级市场干预政策提供了理论依据和操作原则（状态依存的最后买家干预）；（2）为设计适度流动性监管要求提供了指导，避免过度监管抑制市场活动；（3）为中央银行资产负债表的规模和构成提供了政策启示。

title: Selecting Innovation Funding Mechanisms: A Framework for Policymakers
affiliations: , Columbia University, , Harvard University, Dartmouth College and Institute for Progress

detail.title: Selecting Innovation Funding Mechanisms: A Framework for Policymakers
detail.abstract:
The U.S. federal government spends roughly $150 billion a year on research and development through mechanisms ranging from grants and contracts to prizes, advance market commitments, and tax credits. These funding mechanisms differ markedly in risk allocation, decision authority, and incentive power, yet policymakers have little systematic guidance for choosing among them. We develop a framework that asks the policymaker three initial questions about the contracting environment: Can they articulate the work to be done? Can they specify what would constitute a successful solution? Can they identify the most capable performers to contract with? The answers considerably narrow the set of viable mechanisms, enabling a more tractable choice of the efficient mechanism based on further considerations from the innovation-economics literature.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国联邦政府每年通过多种机制（拨款、合同、奖金、预先市场承诺、税收抵免等）投入约1500亿美元用于研发。本文提出一个决策框架，通过三个关键问题（能否清晰描述工作内容、能否明确成功的解决方案、能否识别最有能力的执行者）来缩小可行机制范围，再结合创新经济学文献进一步选择高效机制。
AI.research_question: 政策制定者如何在多种研发资助机制（拨款、合同、奖金、预先市场承诺、税收抵免等）之间进行系统性选择？
AI.motivation: 联邦政府每年在研发上投入约1500亿美元，但各类资助机制在风险分配、决策权和激励强度上存在显著差异，政策制定者缺乏选择这些机制的系统性指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新经济学与契约理论框架，强调风险分配、决策权威与激励力量在机制设计中的权衡。
AI.method: 提出一个规范性决策框架，通过三个初始筛选问题（能否阐明工作内容、能否界定成功方案、能否识别最适格的执行者）缩小可行机制集合，再基于创新经济学文献进行高效机制的选择。
AI.findings: 三个初始问题的回答能显著缩小可行的资助机制范围，使政策制定者能够在更可操作的层面基于创新经济学的进一步考量来选择高效机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为研发资助机制的选择提供了系统性的理论决策框架，将契约理论视角引入公共研发政策领域，弥合了机制差异与选择指导之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在拨款、合同、奖金、预先市场承诺和税收抵免等机制之间提供了可操作的筛选工具和选择指南，有助于提高巨额公共研发资金的使用效率。

title: Employers and Refugee Economic Integration: The Effect of Early Employer Quality
affiliations: University of California, Davis and

detail.title: Employers and Refugee Economic Integration: The Effect of Early Employer Quality

declarations.funderStatement: Caiumi gratefully acknowledges support from the Institute for Humane Studies (grant no. IHS019226).

detail.abstract: Drawing on matched employer-employee data from Denmark, we provide the first causal evidence on role of early employers in the labor market integration of immigrants. First, using the two-way fixed effects model of Abowd, Kramarz, and Margolis (1999), we estimate firm-specific wage premia that we use as a proxy for workplace quality. Second, we leverage the role of social connections and a dispersal policy, which quasi-randomly allocated refugees across municipalities, to obtain exogenous variation in their exposure to the quality of first potential employers. Placement in municipalities where, at arrival, co-nationals are employed by high-quality employers significant increases refugees' employment and earnings for up to ten years. Incorporating employer quality into a data-driven algorithm to optimally match refugees to municipalities leads to a 46% increase in short-run employment probability relative to the status quo policy. Our results imply that the type of employers available upon refugees' first entry is an important determinant of their success in host countries.

AI.tldr: 利用丹麦的匹配雇主-雇员数据，本文首次提供了早期雇主在移民劳动力市场融入中作用的因果证据。研究发现，难民被安置在到达时同国籍者受雇于高质量雇主的城市，能显著提高其长达十年的就业和收入水平。将雇主质量纳入数据驱动的匹配算法，相较于现状政策可使短期就业概率提高46%。
AI.research_question: 早期雇主的质量如何影响移民（特别是难民）的长期劳动力市场融入？
AI.motivation: 移民的劳动力市场融入是重要的政策议题，但已有研究主要关注移民自身的特征（如教育、语言能力），而忽略了早期工作环境——即移民首次进入劳动力市场时雇主质量的作用。本文利用丹麦的独特数据与自然实验填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Abowd, Kramarz, and Margolis (1999)的两向固定效应模型（AKM模型），将企业特定工资溢价作为工作场所质量的代理变量。
AI.method: 1) 使用AKM模型估计企业特定工资溢价；2) 利用社会关系（同国籍网络）和丹麦的难民分散安置政策（准随机分配难民至各城市）获得外生变异，识别早期潜在雇主质量的影响。
AI.findings: 难民被安置到到达时同国籍者就职于高质量雇主的城市，能显著提高其长达十年的就业概率和收入水平。将雇主质量纳入数据驱动的难民-城市最优匹配算法，相较于现状政策，短期就业概率提高46%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供因果证据表明早期雇主质量是移民劳动力市场融入的重要决定因素，将雇主异质性引入移民融入的研究框架，扩展了劳动力市场融入理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民安置政策提供可操作的优化方案——通过将雇主质量纳入安置分配算法，可显著提升难民的短期就业概率，对政策制定具有直接的实践指导意义。

title: The Equilibrium Impact of Credit Frictions: Evidence from Default Risk Using Firm-Level Data
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Economics, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), Bank of England and London School of Economics - Centre for Economic Performance (CEP)

detail.title: The Equilibrium Impact of Credit Frictions: Evidence from Default Risk Using Firm-Level Data
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the impact of credit frictions arising from firm-level default risk on aggregate economic performance. We build a micro-to-macro model with heterogeneous firms and sector-specific production functions, showing that perceived default risk is a sufficient statistic for credit frictions. Using UK administrative data (2004–2019) matched to S&P risk measures, counterfactual estimates reveal that relaxing frictions raises output by 25% and wages by 23%. Ignoring equilibrium wage adjustments overstates output gains, while fixed-capital misallocation approaches understate them. Most gains reflect aggregate capital accumulation. Credit frictions remain above pre-crisis levels, reshape firm size dynamics, increase misallocation across firms, and dampen productivity growth over time.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含异质性企业和部门特定生产函数的微观到宏观模型，利用英国行政数据（2004-2019）匹配S&P风险度量，研究发现企业层面违约风险引发的信贷摩擦是经济表现的关键决定因素。反事实估计表明，放松信贷摩擦可使产出提高25%、工资提高23%，这些收益主要来自总体资本积累，而非简单的要素再配置。信贷摩擦仍高于危机前水平，会重塑企业规模动态、加剧企业间错配并抑制长期生产率增长。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的违约风险所产生的信贷摩擦如何影响总体经济表现？放松信贷摩擦对产出、工资及资源配置会产生多大影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对信贷摩擦的宏观影响存在不同估计方法和结论分歧，尤其是忽略均衡工资调整和固定资本错配的估计方法可能产生偏误。本文希望提供一个统一框架，将感知违约风险作为信贷摩擦的充分统计量，并利用微观数据精确量化信贷摩擦的宏观后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观到宏观（micro-to-macro）模型框架，包含异质性企业和部门特定生产函数；感知违约风险作为信贷摩擦的充分统计量；一般均衡框架中包含内生工资调整和资本积累。
AI.method: 构建微观到宏观的一般均衡模型，使用英国行政数据（2004-2019）与企业层面S&P风险度量进行匹配，通过反事实模拟估计放松信贷摩擦的经济效应，并比较不同模型设定（忽略工资调整vs.固定资本错配）的估计差异。
AI.findings: （1）放松信贷摩擦可使产出提高25%、工资提高23%；（2）忽略均衡工资调整会高估产出收益，而固定资本错配方法会低估收益；（3）大部分收益来自总体资本积累而非要素再配置；（4）信贷摩擦仍高于危机前水平；（5）信贷摩擦重塑企业规模动态、加剧企业间错配并抑制长期生产率增长。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出感知违约风险可作为信贷摩擦的充分统计量，简化了信贷摩擦的度量；（2）将微观企业异质性与总体经济表现纳入统一的一般均衡框架；（3）揭示了不同简化模型设定（忽略工资调整或固定资本）对信贷摩擦宏观效应估计的系统性偏误方向和幅度。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者量化信贷摩擦对产出和工资的影响提供精确估计；（2）指出金融危机后信贷摩擦仍高企，为持续的政策干预提供依据；（3）揭示忽视一般均衡反馈效应的政策评估可能产生误导；（4）对发展中国家获取该研究结果提供了开放获取渠道。

title: The Hidden Cost of Free Speech: Anti-SLAPP Laws and Firm Productivity
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Free Speech: Anti-SLAPP Laws and Firm Productivity
detail.abstract: Does protecting free speech impose costs on firms? We exploit the staggered adoption of U.S. state anti-SLAPP statutes, which shield firms' public critics from retaliatory litigation. Using a stacked differencein-differences design, we find that firm productivity falls 2-3% after adoption. Evidence supports a stakeholder-pressure channel: anti-SLAPP laws increase negative stakeholder-oriented news coverage, expand CSR activities, raise overhead costs, and weaken the sensitivity of investment and hiring to productive opportunities. The productivity decline is larger where stakeholder exposure is greater, managerial discipline weaker, and specialized human capital more important. Our results underscore the tradeoff between public accountability and firm productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国各州反SLAPP法案（保护公众批评者免受报复性诉讼的法律）的分阶段通过作为自然实验，采用堆叠双重差分法发现：该法案通过后，企业生产率下降2-3%。证据支持"利益相关者压力"渠道：反SLAPP法案增加了负面的利益相关者导向新闻报道，扩大了CSR活动，提高了间接费用成本，并削弱了投资和雇佣对生产机会的敏感性。生产率下降在利益相关者暴露度更高、管理层约束更弱、专用人力资本更重要的企业中更为显著。研究揭示了公共问责与企业生产率之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 保护言论自由是否会对企业造成成本？具体而言，反SLAPP法案（保护企业公开批评者免受报复性诉讼）的通过如何影响企业生产率？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注言论自由的法律保护对公共利益的积极影响，但较少探讨这种保护可能对企业产生的成本。反SLAPP法案显著提升了批评者表达和起诉的门槛，为企业外部批评者赋权，可能带来利益相关者压力，从而影响企业运营效率。理解这一权衡对企业治理和公共政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者压力理论：法律制度的改变（反SLAPP法案）赋予外部批评者更强的法律保护，增加了利益相关者的声音和影响力，从而迫使企业将更多资源配置到应对利益相关者关切上（如CSR活动、间接费用），而非生产性投资。
AI.method: 利用美国各州反SLAPP法案的分阶段通过作为准自然实验，采用堆叠双重差分法（stacked difference-in-differences）进行因果推断。使用企业层面的财务数据、新闻媒体数据以及投资和雇佣数据，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 反SLAPP法案通过后，企业生产率下降2-3%；2) 机制上，法案增加了负面的利益相关者导向新闻报道，扩大了CSR活动，提高了间接费用成本，并削弱了投资和雇佣对生产机会的敏感性；3) 异质性上，生产率下降在利益相关者暴露度更高、管理层纪律更弱、专用人力资本更重要的企业中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统性地揭示了言论自由法律保护对企业生产率的负面影响，拓展了法律环境与企业绩效关系的文献；2) 丰富了利益相关者压力理论，表明法律制度改革可以通过改变外部利益相关者的权力结构影响企业资源配置决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了关于反SLAPP法案经济成本（企业生产率损失）的量化证据，有助于在公共问责与企业效率之间做出更均衡的政策决策；2) 为企业管理者提供了理解利益相关者压力如何影响运营效率的洞见，有助于优化资源配置策略。

title: Chinese Sputnik Moments?
affiliations: Harvard Business School - Finance Unit, Boston University, Kellogg School of Management - Department of Finance, Stanford University and Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Chinese Sputnik Moments?
detail.abstract:
China’s technological progress in recent decades has been viewed with admiration, alarm, and (in some cases) doubt. To better understand the Chinese innovation ecosystem, we compile a dataset of almost 14 million domestic Chinese patent publications. We focus on the subset of critical technologies identified by the U.S. Department of Defense. Several surprising patterns emerge from the data: Chinese patenting is strongly associated with other measures of innovative progress; patents are not concentrated in corporate giants such as Huawei; universities have played a key role in innovation, much greater than state-owned enterprises or government-owned facilities; and fewer than one in ten Chinese critical technology patents involves an inventor with U.S. experience or training. Finally, using four text-based measures of patent quality, we show that the rise of Chinese patenting in critical technologies has not been associated with a decline in quality relative to the U.S. awards.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含近1400万件中国国内专利的数据集，聚焦美国国防部认定的关键技术领域，系统分析中国创新生态系统。研究发现：中国专利活动与其他创新指标高度相关；专利并非集中于华为等大型企业；大学在创新中的作用远超国有企业或政府机构；不到十分之一的专利涉及有美国经验或培训的发明人；基于四种文本质量指标，中国关键技术创新专利的质量相对美国并未下降。
AI.research_question: 中国在关键技术领域的专利创新生态有何特征？其创新主体结构如何，专利质量相对美国呈现何种趋势？
AI.motivation: 中国近几十年的技术进步引发国际社会既钦佩又警惕甚至怀疑的复杂态度，需要通过系统数据深入理解中国创新生态的真实面貌，以回应关于中国创新的各种争论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新生态理论与专利质量评估理论，基于美国国防部关键技术分类框架进行专利筛选。
AI.method: 构建近1400万件中国国内专利出版物数据集，聚焦美国国防部认定的关键技术子集，采用描述性统计分析，并使用四种基于文本的专利质量指标进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）中国专利活动与其他创新进展指标高度关联；（2）专利并非集中于华为等企业巨头；（3）大学在创新中扮演关键角色，远超国有企业或政府机构；（4）仅不到十分之一的专利涉及拥有美国经验或培训的发明人；（5）基于四种文本质量指标，中国关键技术的专利质量相对美国并未出现下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解发展中国家（尤其是中国）创新生态系统提供了系统的实证数据支撑，挑战了专利集中于大型企业的传统认知，揭示了大学在转型经济创新中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、国际观察者及相关机构提供了关于中国关键技术专利格局的全面图景，有助于各国评估中国技术竞争力并制定相应的产业与科技政策。

title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Senior Fellow

detail.title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
detail.abstract:
This paper analyzes foreign demand for U.S. assets, with particular emphasis on U.S. Treasury securities. It documents compositional shifts in U.S. bilateral external positions across geographic regions and asset classes, providing estimates of creditor positions closer to a nationality-based concept. While rising U.S. equity prices explain a sizable share of the deterioration in the net external position, foreign purchases of U.S. Treasury securities have been the largest source of U.S. current account financing. The share of these securities held by foreign official investors has declined sharply during the past decade, while the share held by foreign private investors (especially through financial centers) has risen. The decline in foreign official holdings is well explained by lower reserve accumulation, increased Federal Reserve holdings, and dollar appreciation against other reserve currencies. The evidence is consistent with central banks rebalancing their portfolios to avoid large swings in currency shares. Geoeconomic fragmentation is negatively correlated with official demand for U.S. Treasuries, while foreign private demand remains sensitive to safe-haven dynamics. Overall, the paper assesses how these structural shifts affect portfolio preferences for U.S. assets and their potential implications for the U.S. external position amid heightened geopolitical and fiscal uncertainty.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了外国对美国资产（特别是美国国债）的需求，记录了美国双边外部头寸在地理区域和资产类别上的结构性转变，提供了更接近国籍概念的债权国头寸估计。研究发现，尽管美国股票价格上升解释了净外部头寸恶化的大部分，但外国购买美国国债一直是美国经常账户融资的最大来源。过去十年中，外国官方机构持有的国债份额急剧下降，而外国私人投资者（尤其是通过金融中心）持有的份额上升。
AI.research_question: 外国对美国资产（尤其是美国国债）的需求结构发生了什么变化？这些结构性变化如何影响美国外部头寸和资产组合偏好？
AI.motivation: 在地缘政治和财政不确定性加剧的背景下，理解美国外部头寸的演变及其融资来源变化至关重要，特别是外国官方与私人投资者对美元资产需求的结构性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资头寸与经常账户融资理论、中央银行储备资产组合再平衡理论、地缘经济碎片化对外部资产需求的影响分析。
AI.method: 实证分析：利用美国双边外部头寸数据（按地理区域和资产类别分解），估计更接近国籍基础的债权头寸，并通过计量回归分析外国官方和私人持有份额变化的影响因素。
AI.findings: 1) 美国股票价格上涨解释了净外部头寸恶化的相当大份额；2) 外国购买美国国债是经常账户融资的最大来源；3) 外国官方持有份额下降，私人（尤其是金融中心）持有份额上升；4) 官方持有下降可由储备积累减少、美联储持有增加和美元升值解释；5) 央行进行组合再平衡以避免货币份额大幅波动；6) 地缘经济碎片化与官方需求负相关，私人需求对避险动态敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了外国官方与私人投资者对美国资产需求的差异化驱动机制，将地缘经济碎片化纳入对美元资产需求的分析框架，并提供了更接近国籍概念的外部债权估计方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国经常账户融资结构的可持续性、美元资产持有者的构成变化及其在高度不确定环境下的潜在影响提供政策参考。

title: Meritocracy and the Networks It Forged: China’s Imperial Examination
affiliations: and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - 21st Century China Center

detail.title: Meritocracy and the Networks It Forged: China’s Imperial Examination
detail.abstract:
Institutions that claim to reward merit often also serve as engines that drive the formation of important social networks. We examine this dual role in China’s Imperial Examination, one of history’s longest-lived meritocratic systems. We draw on exam performance data for 24,269 individuals across 112 national examinations in the Qing dynasty (1644–1905) and trace who among them rose to become top officials. Strong exam performance increased the likelihood of attaining high office, but advancement also depended on individuals’ ties to powerful examiners. Because performance and ties to powerful examiners were strongly complementary, individuals’ success appeared to rest on merit even as social networks played a role. Following the major political transformations of the 1840s, the importance of examiner ties persisted, although the influential examiners themselves changed. These findings help explain why such systems retain legitimacy even when networks matter greatly.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用清朝112场科举考试中24,269名考生的数据，考察了科举制度中"成绩"与"人脉"的双重作用。研究发现，虽然考试成绩确实能提高晋升高级官员的可能性，但与强大主考官的关系同样重要。由于考试成绩与主考官人脉呈强互补关系，个人的成功表面上看起来是基于功绩，而社会网络实际上也发挥了作用。1840年代重大政治变革后，主考官人脉的重要性得以延续，但掌握影响力的主考官群体发生了变化。这些发现有助于解释为什么即使社会网络很重要，这类制度仍能保持合法性。
AI.research_question: 在宣称奖励功绩的制度中，成绩与社交网络如何共同影响个人晋升？为什么这类制度即使在社会网络发挥重要作用的情况下仍能保持合法性？
AI.motivation: 许多宣称以功绩为导向的制度（如科举）实际上也塑造了重要的社会网络。作者旨在探究这一双重角色的具体运行机制，并解释为何此类制度能在网络中仍维持其合法性，这是理解长期存续的功绩制度的关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于功绩制度与社会网络理论的交叉视角，考察功绩（考试表现）与社会资本（主考官人脉）的互补性及其对晋升结果的影响。
AI.method: 利用清朝（1644-1905）112次全国性科举考试中24,269名考生的考试成绩数据，追踪其中谁晋升为高级官员，通过历史档案数据进行量化实证分析。
AI.findings: 1）较强的考试成绩显著提高晋升高级官员的可能性；2）与强大主考官的关系同样影响晋升；3）考试成绩与主考官人脉呈强互补关系，使得个人成功表面上看似取决于功绩；4）1840年代政治变革后，主考官人脉的重要性持续存在，但影响力较大的主考官群体发生变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了功绩制度中"功绩"与"网络"之间的互补关系机制，解释了这一互补性如何维持制度合法性——即使网络实际发挥作用，由于互补结构的存在，制度仍被视为公平。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代制度中功绩与关系网络的相互作用提供历史参照，有助于解释为何某些看似以功绩为导向的机构即使存在网络影响仍能保持公信力。

title: A Theory of Firm Wage Dynamics
affiliations: IESE Business School and Boston University

detail.title: A Theory of Firm Wage Dynamics
detail.abstract:
We develop a theory of firm wage dynamics that integrates the canonical wage-posting model à la Burdett and Mortensen (1998) with firm dynamics. Firms offer dynamic wage contracts under an equal-treatment constraint in the presence of search frictions. We provide an analytical characterization of equilibrium wage contracts and firm growth as functions only of the distribution of marginal surplus. Consistent with recent empirical evidence, the model implies that (i) firm wages are strongly linked to firm growth but not to firm size; (ii) firm wages decline over the firm life cycle; and (iii) the pass-through of permanent productivity shocks to wages is higher in the short run than in the long run. Firms at the top of the job ladder face excessive labor market competition, so the optimal policy subsidizes their hiring. At the macro level, the optimal policy elevates business dynamism in the steady state, and even more so along the transition.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个整合Burdett-Mortensen（1998）工资竞价模型与企业动态的企业工资动态理论。在搜索摩擦条件下，企业受同等待遇约束提供动态工资合同。模型基于边际剩余分布给出了均衡工资合同与企业增长的解析刻画，并推导出与实证相符的三个关键预测：工资与增长强相关但与规模无关、工资随企业生命周期下降、生产率冲击的短期传递率高于长期。此外，模型发现职位阶梯顶端企业面临过度劳动力市场竞争，最优政策应补贴其雇佣行为，在宏观层面提升稳态及转型期的商业活力。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个将工资竞价模型与企业动态相结合的理论框架，以解释企业工资动态的典型事实，并指导最优政策设计？
AI.motivation: 现有工资竞价模型（如Burdett-Mortensen）通常假设企业工资为静态或外生给定，无法解释企业工资随企业增长、生命周期及生产率冲击而变化的动态特征。近年实证证据显示企业工资与增长密切相关但与企业规模关系较弱，且工资随企业生命衰退，并存在短期冲击传递高于长期的现象，亟需一个统一理论框架来解释这些事实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Burdett-Mortensen（1998）工资竞价模型为基础，引入企业动态（firm dynamics），在搜索摩擦（search frictions）与同等待遇约束（equal-treatment constraint）条件下构建动态工资合同模型。
AI.method: 理论建模与解析推导。构建企业动态与工资竞价相结合的均衡模型，通过边际剩余（marginal surplus）分布函数解析刻画均衡工资合同与企业增长。
AI.findings: （1）企业工资与企业增长强相关，但与企业规模无关；（2）企业工资随企业生命周期递减；（3）永久性生产率冲击对工资的短期传递率高于长期传递率；（4）职位阶梯顶端企业面临过度市场竞争，最优政策应补贴其雇佣；（5）宏观层面，最优政策提升稳态商业活力，且在转型期提升更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典工资竞价文献与企业动态文献有机结合，首次在搜索摩擦加同等待遇约束下给出均衡工资合同和企业增长的解析刻画，为理解企业工资与增长、生命周期及生产率冲击的关系提供了统一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理论依据：识别了职位阶梯顶端企业面临的过度竞争问题，证明补贴其雇佣为最优政策，并指出该政策在稳态与转型期均能提升商业活力（business dynamism），具有明确的政策含义。

title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, Instituto de Analisis Economico (IAE-CSIC) and

detail.title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
detail.abstract:
In the depths of the 2010 financial crisis the Portuguese government enacted a series of reforms in its prescription drug reimbursement system. Over the next three years value added per pharmacist in retail pharmacies fell by a third, reflecting a rise in generic substitution and reductions in the markups allowed for prescription drugs. This massive shock led to pay cuts for incumbent pharmacists and the introduction of a two-tier pay system for new hires, with little or no reduction in the growth of employment. We use detailed longitudinal records from the Quadros de Pessoal data base, merged with information on collective bargaining settlements and firm financial records, to study the impacts of the reforms. We estimate that between 2009 and 2022 average wages of pharmacists fell by a third; most of this reduction was due to lower wages for newly entering cohorts. The implied responsiveness of wages to productivity is substantially above most estimates in the rent-sharing literature, arguably reflecting the strong attachment of workers to the sector and the steady inflow of newly graduating pharmacists. Stepping back, we then consider how wages of pharmacists have diverged relative to wages of other health care professionals in Portugal, and the decisions of recent college applicants to enter the profession.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2010年葡萄牙金融危机期间处方药报销体系改革对零售药店药剂师工资的影响。改革导致药剂师人均附加值下降三分之一，工资相应下降，其中大部分降幅来自新入职群体的工资降低。研究发现工资对生产率的响应弹性显著高于租金分享文献中的大多数估计，反映工人对行业的强烈依附性及新毕业药剂师的持续流入。
AI.research_question: 处方药医保报销制度改革这一外部冲击如何影响药剂师的工资水平及工资结构（特别是新旧雇员之间的工资差异）？
AI.motivation: 2010年葡萄牙金融危机期间，政府实施处方药报销制度改革，导致零售药店药剂师人均附加值大幅下降三分之一，这是一个罕见的、由外部政策冲击驱动的生产率变动，为研究工资对生产率变化如何响应的经典劳动经济学问题提供了理想的自然实验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 租金分享（rent-sharing）理论、劳动力市场依附与人力资本专用性理论、队列效应（cohort effects）与工资设定理论
AI.method: 利用葡萄牙Quadros de Pessoal数据库的详细纵向记录，合并集体谈判协议信息及企业财务记录，对2009-2022年间药剂师工资变化进行实证估计，比较新旧入职队列的工资差异，并与医疗行业其他专业人员工资进行对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）2009至2022年间药剂师平均工资下降三分之一；（2）工资降幅主要源于新入职群体的工资降低（两层级工资体系）；（3）工资对生产率的响应弹性显著高于租金分享文献中的大多数估计；（4）药剂师工资相对其他医疗保健专业人员出现分化，影响大学申请者进入该行业的决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 为租金分享理论提供了新的实证证据，表明在工人行业依附性强、新人持续流入的背景下，工资对生产率的响应弹性可以远超传统估计，拓展了对工资刚性及劳动市场调整机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于医保报销制度改革对劳动力市场冲击效应的实证参考，揭示了工资调整主要通过新雇员而非存量雇员的机制实现，对理解行业工资调整过程及人才供给决策具有现实启示。

title: Demand for Safety in the Crypto Ecosystem
affiliations: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration, City University London - Bayes Business School, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and IESE Business School

detail.title: Demand for Safety in the Crypto Ecosystem
detail.abstract:
We study the demand for safety and liquidity in the crypto ecosystem. We do so under a framework in which a representative investor allocates liquidity across stablecoin deposits in lending pools and traditional safe assets (e.g., MMF shares). Our model delivers three main predictions: (i) the stablecoin deposit premium co-moves with the Treasury premium when investors value the safety and liquidity services of stablecoins; (ii) increases in Treasury supply reduce the stablecoin deposit premium; and (iii) drops in the perceived safety and liquidity of stablecoin deposits (e.g., due to de-pegs or hacker attacks) reduce their premium. Using granular data from hundreds of DeFi pools spanning multiple protocols, tokens, and blockchains, we find evidence supporting these predictions. Investors treat stablecoin deposits as money-like instruments that are borderless and permissionless, yet as fragile as other forms of privately produced safe assets.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加密生态系统中对安全性和流动性的需求。在代表性投资者将流动性配置于借贷池中的稳定币存款和传统安全资产（如货币市场基金份额）的框架下，模型提出三个核心预测：（i）当投资者重视稳定币的安全和流动性服务时，稳定币存款溢价与国债溢价共同波动；（ii）国债供给增加会降低稳定币存款溢价；（iii）稳定币存款安全性和流动性感知的下降（如脱锚或黑客攻击）会降低其溢价。利用覆盖多个协议、代币和区块链的数百个DeFi池的细粒度数据，作者找到了支持这些预测的证据。
AI.research_question: 加密生态系统中投资者对安全性和流动性资产的需求如何形成？稳定币存款在多大程度上被视为类似货币的安全资产，以及其定价如何与传统安全资产（如国债）互动？
AI.motivation: 稳定币已成为加密生态系统中重要的价值储存和交易媒介工具，其总市值庞大且增长迅速。然而，学术界对稳定币存款作为"类货币"安全资产的需求端定价机制缺乏系统性理解。理解稳定币溢价与传统安全资产溢价之间的关系，对于评估稳定币系统的稳定性以及其在全球金融体系中的角色具有重要理论和政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于安全资产需求理论，构建了一个代表性投资者在稳定币存款（DeFi借贷池）和传统安全资产（如MMF份额）之间进行流动性配置的框架。该框架将稳定币存款视为私人生产的"类货币"安全资产，借鉴了货币经济学中关于安全资产稀缺性和流动性溢价的经典分析工具。
AI.method: 首先构建理论模型推导出三个可检验的预测；随后利用覆盖数百个DeFi借贷池、多个协议、多种代币和区块链的细粒度数据进行实证检验，通过检验稳定币存款溢价与国债溢价的共动性、国债供给变化的影响以及稳定币安全性事件（脱锚、黑客攻击）的冲击效应来验证模型预测。
AI.findings: 实证结果支持三个理论预测：（i）稳定币存款溢价与国债溢价显著共动，表明投资者确实重视稳定币的安全和流动性服务；（ii）国债供给增加导致稳定币存款溢价下降，说明传统安全资产的供给会替代对稳定币安全资产的需求；（iii）脱锚事件和黑客攻击等安全性冲击会显著降低稳定币存款溢价。综合表明，投资者将稳定币存款视为无国界、无需许可的货币类工具，但同时也认识到其与其他私人生产的安全资产一样具有脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次在统一框架下将加密生态中的稳定币存款纳入安全资产理论，拓展了私密货币（private money）和安全资产定价的研究边界。揭示了数字经济中"类货币"资产与传统安全资产之间的替代与互补关系，为理解去中心化金融（DeFi）中安全资产的供给与需求机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解稳定币市场的系统性风险提供了实证依据，特别是稳定币与传统金融体系的联动机制。为加密市场参与者提供了关于稳定币溢价驱动因素的定价启示，有助于理解宏观政策（如国债发行）对加密市场的影响传导渠道。对稳定币发行方和DeFi协议设计者评估自身产品的安全性和流动性溢价具有实践参考价值。

title: Time Travel on Professional Profiles
affiliations: , Stanford University - Department of Economics, Revelio Labs and Revelio Labs

detail.title: Time Travel on Professional Profiles
detail.abstract:
Economists increasingly use professional profile data to reconstruct employment histories and measure skill supply. We show that these records are not fixed historical snapshots, but mutable accounts that workers revise over time. Using monthly vintages of Revelio Labs data from 2020–2026, we document that 19.7 percent of established U.S. LinkedIn users retroactively edit the title or description of a job they have already left. These “time-travel” edits are closely tied to labor market transitions: around such edits, workers are much more likely to change employers as compared to later-editing users. This mutability can bias historical measures of skills, but it also reveals workers’ beliefs about which skills are in demand. Retroactive edits show sharp post-2022 increases in AI-related language and recent reductions in work-from-home and DEI language. Finally, LLM-associated writing markers surge after ChatGPT, especially among less-educated groups and MBAs from lower-ranked programs, revealing heterogeneous AI-assisted profile editing.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文使用Revelio Labs 2020-2026年的月度数据，发现19.7%的美国LinkedIn用户会追溯性地编辑已离职工作的职位或描述（即"时间旅行"编辑）。这些编辑与劳动力市场转换密切相关，虽然会扭曲历史技能测量，但能揭示工人对技能需求的认知，如ChatGPT之后AI相关语言激增、远程办公和DEI语言减少，以及AI辅助编辑的异质性。
AI.research_question: 职业档案数据并非固定的历史快照，而是可被用户随时修改的可变账户，这种"时间旅行"编辑如何影响基于档案数据重建就业历史和测量技能供给的准确性？
AI.motivation: 经济学家越来越多地使用专业档案数据（如LinkedIn）来重建就业历史和测量技能供给，但此前研究忽略了这些数据具有可变性，用户会追溯性地修改过去的工作记录，这可能导致对历史技能供给的测量产生偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场信号理论；技能需求与供给的动态匹配理论；AI技术冲击下的劳动市场调整理论
AI.method: 使用Revelio Labs 2020-2026年月度版本数据，统计追溯性编辑的发生率；通过事件分析法分析编辑与雇主转换的关联；利用文本分析方法追踪AI相关语言、远程办公和DEI语言的变化；通过LLM写作标记识别AI辅助编辑的异质性。
AI.findings: 1) 19.7%的美国LinkedIn用户会追溯性编辑已离职工作的标题或描述；2) 这些"时间旅行"编辑与劳动力市场转换紧密相关，编辑前后的用户更可能更换雇主；3) 追溯性编辑显示ChatGPT之后AI相关语言激增，远程办公和DEI语言减少；4) LLM相关写作标记在ChatGPT后激增，尤其在教育程度较低群体和排名较低MBA项目的毕业生中更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示职业档案数据的"活性"特征，挑战将档案视为静态历史记录的假设；提出追溯性编辑是工人对技能需求认知的信号机制，为劳动力市场信号理论提供新证据；展示AI技术冲击如何通过档案编辑行为影响技能供给的测量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用职业档案数据进行实证研究的经济学家提供方法警示，提醒注意数据可变性带来的测量偏差；为政策制定者和企业提供关于技能需求动态变化的最新洞察；揭示AI辅助下的档案编辑行为差异，有助于理解技术进步对人力资本记录的影响。

title: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
affiliations: Stanford University, Yale University, MIT and Stanford University - Department of Political Science

detail.title: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
detail.abstract:
We study the effects of H-1B immigration on U.S. industries that employ H-1B workers and their trading partners. Using a novel cross-industry design and the 1999–2003 expansion of the H-1B visa cap for identification, we find that H-1B exposure raised incomes for natives and pre-existing immigrants, with gains concentrated in non-STEM occupations. Income gains propagate forward through supply chains to downstream industries but not backward to upstream industries, consistent with a productivity shock rather than a labor supply shock. We find no direct effect on patenting, suggesting that productivity gains arise from better task execution rather than patentable invention.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1999-2003年H-1B签证上限扩张作为识别策略，通过跨行业设计研究H-1B移民对美国雇佣行业及其贸易伙伴的影响。研究发现H-1B移民暴露度提高了本地人和原有移民的收入，收益集中在非STEM职业。收入收益通过供应链向前传导至下游行业，但未向后传导至上游行业，这与生产率冲击而非劳动力供给冲击一致。对专利申请无直接影响，表明生产率提升来自更好的任务执行而非可专利的发明。
AI.research_question: H-1B移民如何影响美国雇佣H-1B工人的行业及其贸易伙伴的收入和生产率？
AI.motivation: 以往关于H-1B移民影响的研究多聚焦于企业或劳动力市场层面，缺乏对行业间（尤其是通过供应链传导）的收入和生产率影响的系统性理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，区分生产率冲击和劳动力供给冲击两种机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率冲击理论（productivity shock）与劳动力供给冲击理论（labor supply shock）的区分框架；行业间供应链传导机制。
AI.method: 跨行业计量设计（cross-industry design），利用1999-2003年H-1B签证上限扩张作为外生冲击进行识别（identification）。
AI.findings: （1）H-1B移民暴露度提高了本地人和原有移民的收入，收益集中在非STEM职业；（2）收入收益通过供应链向前传导至下游行业，但未向后传导至上游行业，与生产率冲击一致；（3）对专利申请无直接影响，表明生产率提升来自更好的任务执行而非可专利的发明。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文实证区分了H-1B移民带来的生产率冲击与劳动力供给冲击两种理论机制，并揭示了移民收益通过供应链传导的方向性特征，丰富了移民经济学和行业间溢出效应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估H-1B签证政策的经济效应提供行业层面的实证证据，有助于理解移民对本国工人收入分配及产业链上下游的影响，对签证配额政策的调整具有参考价值。

title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
affiliations: Stanford University - Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research

detail.title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
detail.abstract:
This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了金融素养领域的文献，涵盖Big Three三问测量工具的起源、28题的金融知识测量体系，指出全球金融素养水平普遍偏低且未随时间改善，并探讨了金融素养对储蓄、退休规划等财务行为的影响，以及金融教育项目的成本效益和课程改革成效。
AI.research_question: 金融素养的测量方法、全球水平现状、对财务行为的影响，以及金融教育干预措施的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 金融素养是影响个体财务决策和福利的关键因素，但其全球水平偏低且未改善，需要系统梳理文献以理解现状并为政策干预提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融素养理论、人力资本理论、行为金融理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统梳理金融素养相关的测量研究、跨国比较研究、行为结果研究和教育干预评估研究。
AI.findings: 1) Big Three问题成为金融素养测量的标准工具；2) 全球金融素养水平普遍偏低且未随时间改善；3) 金融素养与预防性储蓄、退休规划等财务行为正相关；4) 金融教育项目数量激增，但成本效益需要审慎评估；5) 高中和大学个人理财课程有助于提升金融知识和后续财务行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了金融素养的测量范式、决定因素和行为后果的理论框架，为后续研究提供了系统的理论地图。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育者提供了金融教育干预有效性的证据基础，指出将个人理财课程纳入学校课程体系的可行性和价值。

title: Unpacking Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in a Large-Scale Dropout-Prevention Experiment
affiliations: Stanford University, Department of Economics, University of Notre Dame, Cornell University, University of Notre Dame and University of Notre Dame - Department of Economics and Econometrics

detail.title: Unpacking Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in a Large-Scale Dropout-Prevention Experiment
detail.abstract:
Timely high school completion is a critical step in successful transitions to post-secondary schooling and the labor market. This randomized controlled trial, deployed in two urban, disadvantaged school districts, tests the effectiveness of a mature and comprehensive student-support program on an unusually large scale (n=2,528). While overall effects on graduation rates are small and statistically insignificant, exploratory analyses reveal notable variation by site and over time, mirroring heterogeneity in treatment timing and program implementation. These findings highlight the challenges of scaling interventions and raise concerns about generalizing results from small-scale, single-site evaluations.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 这项随机对照试验在两个城市弱势学区大规模实施了一个成熟的学生支持项目（n=2,528），发现总体毕业率效应较小且统计上不显著，但探索性分析显示不同地点和时间存在显著差异，反映了治疗时机和实施过程的异质性，凸显了干预措施规模化的挑战。
AI.research_question: 一个成熟且全面的学生支持项目在大型随机对照试验中能否有效提高高中按时毕业率？特别是当项目从单一地点小规模实施扩展到两个城市弱势学区的大规模实施时，其效果是否能够保持？
AI.motivation: 按时完成高中学业是成功过渡到高等教育和劳动力市场的关键步骤。以往小规模、单地点评估显示学生支持项目的有效性，但缺乏在大规模、多地点背景下检验其效果的证据。本研究旨在探讨干预措施规模化实施面临的实际挑战，并警示从小规模单点评估推广结论的潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于随机对照试验（RCT）的实验设计框架，涉及干预措施规模化的相关理论，即从小规模试点到大规模推广过程中的效果衰减机制，包括实施异质性、治疗时机差异等。
AI.method: 采用随机对照试验（RCT）方法，在两个城市弱势学区大规模实施，样本量为2,528名学生。使用随机分配将学生分为治疗组和对照组，评估项目对按时高中毕业率的影响，并进行探索性亚组分析以考察不同地点和时间上的异质性。
AI.findings: 整体上，该学生支持项目对高中毕业率的平均效应较小且统计上不显著。然而，探索性分析揭示了不同实施地点和不同时间阶段之间存在显著的效果差异，这种差异与治疗时机和项目实施过程的异质性相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究对干预措施规模化的理论做出了贡献，揭示了从小规模单站点评估到大规模多站点实施过程中，干预效果可能因实施异质性和治疗时机差异而显著变化，为理解规模化过程中的效果衰减机制提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为政策制定者和教育实践者提供了重要警示：对小规模试点项目的成功结论不应急于推广到更大范围。大规模实施面临着场景差异和实施质量不一致等现实挑战，需要更加审慎地规划规模化策略，并充分考虑实施过程中的异质性因素。

title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia University - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
detail.abstract:
Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2025年美国关税对消费者价格的传导效应，发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。直接效应占其中64%，即关税直接推高外国品种的消费者价格；间接效应占36%，源于关税提高美国生产者进口投入成本，以及国内生产商因进口竞争减弱而提高加价。直接效应传导迅速，而间接效应需9至12个月才能通过供应链显现，因此关税对消费者的影响比仅考虑直接效应更大且更持久。
AI.research_question: 关税在多大程度上以及通过何种渠道传导至消费者价格？具体而言，直接效应（关税对外国品种价格的影响）和间接效应（通过进口投入品成本与国内厂商加价行为）分别如何贡献于消费者价格的整体涨幅？
AI.motivation: 标准关税传导（pass-through）估计主要关注关税对进口价格的影响，严重低估了关税对国内生产的商品价格的影响。已有文献忽视了关税通过国内生产商抬价和进口投入品成本上升这两条间接渠道对消费者价格的传导，因此有必要全面评估关税的真实消费者价格效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税传导理论（tariff pass-through）、直接与间接传导效应分解、不完全竞争下的加价（markup）理论、供应链成本传导理论
AI.method: 以2025年美国关税为自然实验，采用相对于低暴露商品（less-exposed goods）的比较分析框架，在控制总体宏观条件（aggregate conditions）固定的情况下，估计关税对消费者价格的传导率，并分解直接效应与间接效应的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格；（2）直接效应占64%，来自关税直接推高外国品种消费者价格；（3）间接效应占36%，来自进口投入品成本上升以及国内生产者因进口竞争减弱而提高加价；（4）直接效应传导迅速（进口价格几乎立即上升），而间接效应需9至12个月才经由供应链显现；（5）关税对消费者的影响比直接效应单独所显示得更大且更持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将关税对消费者价格的传导分解为直接效应与间接效应，揭示间接效应（进口投入成本和国内厂商加价调整）在关税传导中不可忽视的贡献；拓展了关税传导文献由仅关注进口价格延伸到国内生产商品价格的完整分析框架；指出关税的消费者影响具有更强的时间持久性，超越了标准直接效应所暗示的幅度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税政策的实际消费者成本提供了更全面的量化依据；提示仅依据传统关税传导率将严重低估关税的通胀效应；关税对消费者的影响更为持久（需9-12个月完全显现），政策评估需考虑这一时间维度的滞后性。

title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
detail.abstract:
Can automation harm workers without replacing them? We study jobs in which workers value both producing useful output and knowing that the output depends on their own contribution. A credible machine alternative can weaken that second source of meaning even when the firm retains the worker. Our model shows that this loss raises compensation when wages adjust fully; when they adjust only partly, workers bear some of the loss themselves. It can also make automation more likely. An external developer may profit by publicly demonstrating a machine before licensing it, because the demonstration lowers the value of the human alternative. This "meaning externality" can create demand for the machine and make profitable development socially harmful. Better technical quality and greater public salience have different effects: quality improves output, while salience alone weakens human work. Automation can, therefore, reduce the value of work before it eliminates jobs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动化如何在不取代工人的情况下损害工人。当工人既重视产出又重视自身贡献的意义感时，可信的机器替代品会削弱工作意义的第二来源，即使企业保留工人。这会推高补偿成本（工资完全调整时）或由工人自行承担（工资部分调整时），并可能使自动化更可能被采纳。外部开发者可能通过先公开展示机器来获利，因为展示降低了人类替代方案的价值，这种"意义外部性"可能使盈利的开发对社会有害。技术质量与公众可见度有不同效应：质量提升产出，而单纯可见度削弱人类工作。
AI.research_question: 自动化能否在不直接取代工人的情况下对工人造成伤害？具体而言，可信的机器替代方案如何通过削弱工作意义感而影响工人福利、工资与企业自动化决策？
AI.motivation: 传统自动化研究关注岗位替代（失业），但现实中许多自动化场景并未直接导致裁员，却仍可能降低工人福利。本文旨在解释一种此前被忽视的机制——"意义外部性"——即机器存在的纯粹示范效应即可削弱人类工作的内在意义，从而为自动化研究提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作意义理论（workers value both producing useful output and knowing the output depends on their own contribution），构建包含"产出效用"与"贡献感知效用"双重来源的效用函数模型，分析机器替代品对意义感的侵蚀及其经济后果。
AI.method: 理论建模与比较静态分析。构建工人在保留劳动岗位但面临可信机器替代时的效用与工资决定模型，分析工资完全调整与部分调整两种情形，并纳入外部开发者的策略行为。
AI.findings: （1）机器替代品削弱工人的贡献意义感，即使企业不裁员；（2）工资完全调整时损失转由企业承担（补偿上升），工资部分调整时工人自行承担部分损失；（3）意义损失可能提高自动化采纳概率；（4）外部开发者可通过公开展示机器来降低人类替代方案价值从而获利，形成"意义外部性"；（5）技术质量与公众可见度效应不同：质量提升产出，可见度单独削弱人类工作价值；（6）自动化可在消除岗位之前先降低工作的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"意义外部性"（meaning externality）概念，将工作意义纳入自动化经济学分析框架，解释自动化不取代岗位也能伤害工人的机制，扩展了自动化对劳动市场影响的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于自动化社会成本的警示——即使不裁员，自动化的公众可见性本身也可能损害工人福利；提示企业需关注技术展示的时机与方式，也提示监管者考虑"意义外部性"造成的社会福利损失。

title: Monetary Policy in Mandarin Capitalism
affiliations: and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Monetary Policy in Mandarin Capitalism
detail.abstract:
This paper investigates why China’s recurrent credit expansions have coincided with persistently weak inflation. We argue that this pattern reflects the country’s production-oriented monetary regime. At the aggregate level, faster monetary-financial expansion temporarily raises PPI inflation but depresses it over longer horizons. At the sectoral level, liability growth among listed industrial firms is followed by weaker producer prices, lower profitability, higher leverage, rising inventories, and reduced capacity utilization. We also find asymmetric supply-chain transmission: downstream liability growth raises upstream PPI inflation, while upstream liability growth does not generate a corresponding downstream price response. These findings indicate that credit expansion in China tends to sustain production and balance sheets rather than stimulate final demand. As a result, monetary policy operates less as a conventional tool for demand management and durable reflation, and more as a mechanism for preserving production capacity and supporting growth.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中国周期性信用扩张为何伴随持续疲弱的通货膨胀，提出中国实行"生产导向型货币体制"的解释。研究发现：总体层面，货币金融扩张在短期内推高PPI通胀但长期压低；行业层面，上市工业企业负债增长与更弱的出厂价格、更低盈利、更高杠杆、更高库存及更低产能利用率相关；供应链层面存在不对称传导——下游负债增长推高上游PPI通胀，而反之不成立。这表明中国的信用扩张更多是维持生产和平衡资产负债表，而非刺激最终需求，货币政策因此更偏向保生产产能和支持增长，而非传统需求管理工具。
AI.research_question: 中国为何反复出现信用扩张却伴随持续疲弱的通货膨胀？货币政策在中国的作用机制与传统需求管理工具有何差异？
AI.motivation: 中国信用扩张与通胀疲弱并存的"低通胀增长"现象难以用传统货币理论解释，需要从中国独特的货币体制视角提供新的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产导向型货币体制（Production-Oriented Monetary Regime）理论，强调货币政策的核心目标为维持生产能力和支持增长，而非传统需求管理。
AI.method: 采用聚合层面时间序列分析和行业层面面板数据分析，利用上市工业企业负债数据，考察信用扩张对PPI通胀、盈利能力、杠杆率、库存和产能利用率的影响，并进行供应链上下游传导的实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）货币金融扩张短期推高PPI通胀但长期压低；（2）工业部门负债增长伴随更弱的价格、更低盈利、更高杠杆、更高库存和更低产能利用率；（3）供应链传导不对称：下游负债增长推高上游PPI，而上游负债增长不引发下游价格响应；（4）信用扩张倾向于维持生产和资产负债表而非刺激最终需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"生产导向型货币体制"概念框架，解释了中国信用扩张与通胀疲弱并存的悖论，丰富了关于发展中大国货币政策传导机制的理论认识，揭示了货币政策在不同经济体制下的差异化角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国货币政策效果提供实证依据，提示政策制定者中国货币政策作为需求管理和持久再通胀工具的局限性，有助于重新评估货币扩张在保增长与稳物价之间的权衡。

title: Common Ownership and Collusion
affiliations: , Boston University - Markets, Public Policy, and Law and University College Dublin

detail.title: Common Ownership and Collusion
detail.abstract:
We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了首个实证证据，表明共同所有权可以促进企业间的显性合谋。利用瑞典合法卡特尔（垄断联盟）的独特数据集，作者避免了检测偏差问题，发现企业间利润权重（κ）越高，参与卡特尔的概率越大、持续时间越长，且卡特尔解散后利润权重会立即下降。
AI.research_question: 共同所有权是否以及如何影响企业参与显性合谋（卡特尔）的行为？
AI.motivation: 以往关于共同所有权与合谋的研究主要聚焦于隐性合谋（如行业层面的竞争效应），缺乏对显性合谋的直接证据。同时，传统研究基于被检测出的卡特尔样本存在严重的样本选择偏差。瑞典的合法卡特尔登记制度提供了观测全部卡特尔（包括形成、持续和解散）的独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同所有权理论——企业通过利润权重（κ）内化竞争对手的利润，从而降低了竞争激励；显性合谋的经济学理论。
AI.method: 基于瑞典全部注册卡特尔的数据库与手工收集的股权数据，计算企业配对的利润权重（κ），采用实证回归分析检验利润权重与卡特尔参与、持续时间及解散后调整之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）更高的利润权重与更大的卡特尔参与概率相关，并能预测未来的卡特尔参与；（2）高利润权重与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关；（3）卡特尔解散后企业利润权重立即降低；（4）上述关系集中在“内化方参与合谋而对手不参与”的企业对中，即共同所有权对自身合谋起补充作用，但替代了对手的合谋参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在显性合谋场景下提供共同所有权影响的直接实证证据；揭示了共同所有权在合谋中的异质性作用（补充与替代并存）；通过利用合法卡特尔样本克服了样本选择偏差这一方法论局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构提供了新的政策启示：共同所有权不仅可能促进隐性合谋，也可能助长显性卡特尔的形成与维持；为竞争政策的制定与执法提供了实证依据。

title: Incomplete Information and Self-Fulfilling Inflation Dynamics—Lucas meets Keynes
affiliations: New York University - Leonard N. Stern School of Business - Department of Economics, Peking University HSBC Business School and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), Antai College of Economics and Management, Students

detail.title: Incomplete Information and Self-Fulfilling Inflation Dynamics—Lucas meets Keynes
detail.abstract:
This paper incorporates the Lucas (1973) island model into a standard DSGE framework. It demonstrates that self-fulfilling stochastic inflation equilibria, which are driven by intrinsic uncertainty or pure sentiments, can exist under rational expectations. Furthermore, it shows that these sentiment-driven stochastic equilibria exhibit monetary non-neutrality, even when the fundamental equilibrium is unique and monetarily neutral. As the aggregate price or inflation rate can appear to fluctuate independently of the money supply, our model explains the complex relationship between inflation and the money supply in the real world, where the basic quantity theory of money often seems invalid.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将Lucas（1973）岛屿模型嵌入标准DSGE框架，证明了在理性预期下，由内在不确定性或纯粹情绪驱动的自我实现随机通胀均衡可以存在，且情绪驱动的随机均衡即使在基础均衡唯一且货币中性时也表现出货币非中性，从而解释了现实世界中通胀与货币供应之间复杂关系以及基本货币数量论常常失效的现象。
AI.research_question: 在标准DSGE框架中，情绪冲击能否产生自我实现的随机通胀均衡，以及这种均衡是否会导致货币非中性？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中通胀与货币供应之间的关系往往与基本货币数量论不符，通胀似乎可以独立于货币供应而波动，因此需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lucas（1973）岛屿模型、DSGE框架、理性预期、货币数量论
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析
AI.findings: （1）在理性预期下，由内在不确定性或纯粹情绪驱动的自我实现随机通胀均衡可以存在；（2）情绪驱动的随机均衡即使在基础均衡唯一且货币中性时，也能产生货币非中性；（3）模型能够解释通胀与货币供应之间看似独立波动的复杂关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Lucas岛屿模型与标准DSGE框架相结合，为自我实现随机通胀均衡的存在性提供了新的理论基础；证明了在基础均衡货币中性时，情绪驱动均衡仍可导致货币非中性，对货币数量论和货币中性理论提出了重要修正。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实世界中通胀与货币供应的复杂关系提供了新的分析框架；有助于解释货币数量论失效的现象，对货币政策制定具有重要的政策启示。

title:
Do Time Series Foundation Models Know Their Tails? 

A Mechanism-Oriented, Contamination-Aware Audit of Zero-Shot Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall

detail.title:
Do Time Series Foundation Models Know Their Tails? 

A Mechanism-Oriented, Contamination-Aware Audit of Zero-Shot Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Can zero-shot time series foundation models supply reliable tail-risk forecasts? Under a contamination-aware, pre-specified protocol we audit Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall from five deployed heads on 32 daily series across extraction rules, regimes, and training-free repairs. Native deep tails are structurally unusable or extraction-dependent. The diagnosis is organized by two within-family contrasts (Chronos-2's quantile head versus Chronos-Bolt's bounded grid versus Chronos-base's token-sampling head, and Moirai-1.1's mixture head versus Moirai-2.0's quantile head) and one cross-form contrast (Moirai-2.0's quantile head versus Lag-Llama's parametric Student-t head). The contrasts are associative, not causal; the token-sampling head suffers an order-of-magnitude scale collapse no extraction rule repairs, and regime failures are head-specific. Replacing the conditional scale is decisive; location is second-order at the daily one-step horizon. A TSFM-location/GARCH-scale hybrid meets the pre-specified criterion on all five core heads and matches, does not exceed, classical GARCH-EVT. Forecast form, not model label, comes first in a tail-risk audit.

AI.tldr: 本文对零样本时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在尾部风险预测中的可靠性进行了系统性审计。作者在污染感知的预先指定协议下，评估了5个已部署模型头在32个日度序列上的VaR和ES表现，覆盖不同提取规则、市场体制和无训练修复方式。研究发现：原生深度尾部在结构上不可用或高度依赖提取方式；token采样头存在无法修复的量级塌缩；体制失败具有头特异性。替换条件尺度是决定性的，位置参数次要。最终提出TSFM-location/GARCH-scale混合模型，在所有五个核心头上达到预定标准，并与经典GARCH-EVT表现相当但不超越。"预测形式而非模型标签"在尾部风险审计中优先。
AI.research_question: 零样本时间序列基础模型能否提供可靠的尾部风险（VaR和ES）预测？其预测头的结构形式（而非模型品牌）如何影响尾部风险预测的可靠性？
AI.motivation: 深度时间序列基础模型日益被用于金融尾部风险预测，但其原生输出（如分位数、token采样、参数分布）是否在零样本条件下具备统计可靠性尚不清楚。已有研究多关注点预测或分位数中位数表现，缺乏对极端尾部（VaR/ES）的系统性审计，且忽略预测头结构差异的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（EVT）、污染感知的预先指定审计协议、尾部风险度量（VaR/ES）、GARCH族模型、时间序列基础模型预测头分类学（分位数头、token采样头、参数分布头、混合头）
AI.method: 采用污染感知的预先指定协议，对5个已部署TSFM头（Chronos-2分位数头、Chronos-Bolt有界网格、Chronos-base token采样头、Moirai-1.1混合头、Moirai-2.0分位数头、Lag-Llama参数Student-t头）在32个日度序列上进行VaR和ES审计。通过组内对比（Chronos系列、Moirai系列）和跨形式对比（Moirai-2.0 vs Lag-Llama）识别头结构特征，并测试无训练修复方案（条件尺度替换等），最终构建TSFM-location/GARCH-scale混合模型。
AI.findings: （1）原生深度尾部在结构上不可用或严重依赖提取规则；（2）token采样头遭遇数量级尺度塌缩，任何提取规则都无法修复；（3）体制失败具有头特异性（head-specific）；（4）替换条件尺度（scale）是决定性的，位置（location）在日度单步预测中二阶重要；（5）TSFM-location/GARCH-scale混合模型在所有五个核心头上满足预定标准，与经典GARCH-EVT相当但不超越。核心结论：预测形式（head form）而非模型标签决定尾部风险审计表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"预测形式优先"的分析框架，将尾部风险审计的关注点从模型品牌转向预测头结构；系统化了TSFM预测头分类学对尾部风险的映射关系（分位数头、token采样头、参数头各有不同的尾部分布行为）；识别了token采样头的尺度塌缩这一结构性缺陷，并区分了条件尺度与位置在尾部预测中的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了针对TSFM尾部风险预测的污染感知审计协议，可作为行业基准；为实践者提供"模型选择应基于预测头形式而非品牌"的决策指南；提出TSFM-location/GARCH-scale混合修复方案，能够在零样本TSFM的基础上达到经典GARCH-EVT的水平，为金融机构在不放弃深度模型的情况下获得可靠尾部风险度量提供了可操作路径。

title: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
affiliations: , Princeton University and Rutgers University, New Brunswick - Robert Wood Johnson Medical School

detail.title: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
detail.abstract:
We use U.S. nationally representative longitudinal data to estimate the effects of cognitive and behavioral impairments in childhood on health in adulthood. We focus on work-limiting health conditions and fair or poor self-rated health but also consider adequacy of sleep, body weight, and health behaviors (use of various substances and preventive health care) as potential pathways. In household fixed effects models, we find that both impairments are strongly associated with having a work-limiting health condition in adulthood; specifically, cognitive impairments increase the probability of a work-limiting condition by 70% and behavioral impairments increase the probability by 60%. Individuals with cognitive impairments in childhood are 43% more likely to report being in fair or poor health in adulthood compared to individuals without cognitive impairments. The effects of cognitive impairments on health do not appear to operate through insufficient sleep, obesity, or health behaviors. Individuals with childhood behavioral impairments are no more likely to report being in fair or poor health but are more likely to get insufficient sleep and to be obese, compared to individuals without behavioral impairments, suggesting that insufficient sleep and obesity could potentially lie on the pathway from behavioral impairments in childhood to work-limiting health conditions in adulthood.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国全国代表性的纵向数据，估计童年期认知和行为损伤对成年期健康的影响。研究发现认知损伤使成年期工作限制性健康状况的概率增加70%，行为损伤使其增加60%；认知损伤使自评健康不佳的概率增加43%。行为损伤虽不直接影响自评健康，但通过睡眠不足和肥胖等途径间接影响成年期工作限制性健康状态。
AI.research_question: 童年期的认知损伤和行为损伤如何影响成年期的健康状况？其潜在的作用路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 童年期健康问题对成年期健康结果具有长期深远影响，但以往研究较少系统区分认知损伤与行为损伤各自独立的长期健康后果，也缺乏对其作用路径（如睡眠、体重、健康行为等）的深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期视角下的健康累积理论——童年期健康资本（认知与行为损伤）通过影响生活方式、健康行为及生物机制，进而塑造成年期健康结局。
AI.method: 使用美国全国代表性的纵向数据，采用家庭固定效应模型（household fixed effects models）进行估计，比较家庭内兄弟姐妹之间童年期损伤的差异对成年期健康的影响。
AI.findings: （1）认知损伤使成年期工作限制性健康条件的概率增加70%，行为损伤使其增加60%；（2）认知损伤使自评健康不佳的概率增加43%，但该效应不通过睡眠不足、肥胖或健康行为起作用；（3）行为损伤不显著影响自评健康，但显著增加睡眠不足和肥胖的概率，表明这两者可能是从童年行为损伤到成年期工作限制性健康条件的潜在路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了认知损伤与行为损伤在成年期健康后果上的差异化影响机制，明确了行为损伤通过睡眠和肥胖等中间变量间接影响健康的路径，增进了对童年期损伤长期健康后果传导机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童早期健康干预提供实证依据：针对行为损伤儿童的睡眠和体重管理干预可能有助于降低其成年期健康风险，而针对认知损伤儿童则需关注更直接的健康照护支持。

title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Bocconi University, Australian National University (ANU) and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
detail.abstract:
Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing “nudges” and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过元分析整合了超过600项研究、1200多个估计值，比较"助推"（nudge）类行为干预与传统价格干预在烟草、酒精、流感疫苗、电力和居民用水五个市场中的效果。研究发现，行为干预的效果可转化为巨大的财政干预等价物（从11%的电税到100%的流感疫苗补贴），且在所有市场中更具成本效益。然而，成本效益并不预测政策的福利排序。基于行为扩展的公共资金边际价值框架，论文指出助推在边际上具有高福利回报，而价格工具在规模上往往产生更大的总剩余。
AI.research_question: 行为干预（助推）相对于传统价格政策在经济意义和福利效应上究竟有多大价值？如何在不同政策之间进行可比较的评估？
AI.motivation: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心工具，但其估计处理效应往往较小，导致其经验价值备受争议。现有评估缺乏统一的比较框架来判定行为干预是否具有经济意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共资金边际价值（Marginal Value of Public Funds）的行为扩展框架；政策效果的等价价格转换方法。
AI.method: 元分析：整合超过600项研究、1200多个估计值，比较助推与价格干预在五个市场中的效果；将助推效果转化为等效价格变化；进行成本效益分析和福利排序分析。
AI.findings: （1）行为干预常对应于巨大的财政干预规模，从11%的电税到100%的流感疫苗补贴；（2）助推在所有市场中比价格工具更具成本效益；（3）成本效益并不预测政策的福利排序；（4）助推在边际上具有高福利回报，而价格工具在规模上产生更大的总剩余。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了行为扩展的公共资金边际价值框架，为比较行为干预与传统价格政策提供了统一的理论工具；揭示了成本效益与福利排序之间的非对应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了跨政策类型的系统比较证据，表明行为干预（助推）在边际上具有高福利回报但规模受限，而价格工具适合大规模应用，为政策组合选择提供了实证基础。

title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
detail.abstract:
The study of bureaucracy as a key dimension of state capacity has gained increasing attention in economics. What organizational features create an effective bureaucracy, however, remains subject to debate. This paper focuses on the central role of civil service protections in delineating the boundary between politics and administration. I introduce a simple principal-agent framework to discuss the key theoretical channels through which political insulation can shape bureaucrat performance. Guided by the framework, I establish stylized facts and organize evidence from historical and contemporary civil service reforms.
