AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了发展中国家股票市场与发达市场金融一体化程度的年度定量估计，有助于投资决策和风险管理。

title: Climate Smart Agroforestry for Restoration of Degraded Peatlands and Contribution to Climate and Livelihood Goals in South Sumatra
affiliations: Center for International Forestry Research, CIFOR-ICRAF, CIFOR-ICRAF, affiliation not provided to SSRN, CIFOR-ICRAF, Ayer Rajah Crescent , CIFOR-ICRAF, BRIN and CIFOR-ICRAF

detail.title: Climate Smart Agroforestry for Restoration of Degraded Peatlands and Contribution to Climate and Livelihood Goals in South Sumatra
detail.abstract: South Sumatra has a large area of peatlands (i.e. 1.06 to 1.5 million ha, based on the mapping methodology), and much of these peatlands are converted to other land uses, made it more vulnerable to fire. This area is therefore, one of the nation’s important peatland restoration targets. The main objective of this paper is to review various agroforestry systems exist in the peatlands in Indonesia, and based on that, identify potential agroforestry models suitable to practice in South Sumatra’s peatland area. Reviewed data were then analyzed through narrative qualitative and narrative comparative methods with careful compilation and scientific interpretation. There are various agroforestry systems exist in the Indonesian peatlands providing multiple ecosystem benefits to local and wider scale. However, considering potential benefits for the peatlands in South Sumatra, i.e. restoration, biodiversity conservation, diversifying farm production, and socioeconomic benefits, our suggested agroforestry models are the combination of various trees, with understory crops, fishery and honey. Besides various benefits provided by agroforestry, including its strong roles achieving nine out of seventeen sustainable development goals (SDGs), further investigation from crop ecophysiology to market mechanisms, will be required for wider agroforestry adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了印度尼西亚泥炭地中存在的各种农林复合经营系统，并基于此为南苏门答腊泥炭地区域提出适合的农林复合经营模式建议。通过叙事性定性和叙事性比较方法分析数据，建议采用树木与林下作物、渔业和蜂蜜相结合的复合模式，以获得恢复、生物多样性保护、农业生产多样化和社会经济等多重效益。
AI.research_question: 印度尼西亚泥炭地中存在哪些农林复合经营系统？哪些农林复合经营模式适合在南苏门答腊泥炭地区域实践？
AI.motivation: 南苏门答腊拥有大面积泥炭地（约106万至150万公顷），但其中大部分被转为其他土地利用方式，使其更易发生火灾，成为国家重要的泥炭地恢复目标区域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农林复合经营理论、泥炭地恢复与生态系统服务理论、可持续发展目标框架
AI.method: 叙事性定性分析法和叙事性比较法，辅以系统性的文献汇编和科学解读
AI.findings: 印度尼西亚泥炭地中存在多种农林复合经营系统，为当地和更广泛区域提供多重生态系统效益。建议的农林复合模式包括树木与林下作物、渔业和蜂蜜相结合的综合模式。农林复合经营在实现17个可持续发展目标中的9个方面发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了印度尼西亚泥炭地农林复合经营系统的类型与分布，为泥炭地恢复提供了基于生态学和社会经济学整合的实践框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南苏门答腊泥炭地的恢复与管理提出了具体的农林复合经营模式建议，涵盖作物生态生理到市场机制等多层面的推广路径，有助于实现可持续发展目标。

title: Disagreement on Volatility
affiliations: Shenzhen University

detail.title: Disagreement on Volatility
detail.abstract: We study how disagreement about future risk shapes stock prices. Guided by a two-dimensional belief framework distinguishing risk disagreement from return disagreement, we construct a machine-learning-based stock-level measure of disagreement about future return volatility (DOV). DOV negatively predicts subsequent stock returns in the cross section and retains incremental predictive power beyond established measures of return disagreement. Consistent with the portfolio-demand mechanism, high-DOV stocks have lower institutional ownership, experience subsequent reductions in institutional holdings, and exhibit lower future trading activity. The negative DOV-return relation is stronger for firms with greater valuation uncertainty and more severe limits to arbitrage. A bottom-up aggregate of stock-level DOV also negatively predicts future market returns. Our findings identify heterogeneous risk beliefs as a distinct second dimension of investor disagreement and highlight their implications for portfolio allocation, market participation, and asset pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于机器学习的股票层面风险分歧度量指标（DOV），发现其对横截面股票收益具有负向预测能力，且独立于已有的收益分歧指标。DOV的预测能力与投资组合需求机制一致，并在市场层面同样具有预测力。
AI.research_question: 投资者对未来风险的异质信念（风险分歧）如何影响股票价格？风险分歧是否构成与收益分歧不同的第二个维度，并在资产定价中发挥独立作用？
AI.motivation: 已有文献主要关注投资者对未来收益的分歧（收益分歧），但投资者对未来波动率/风险的分歧（风险分歧）在理论框架中同样重要且尚未被充分实证检验。本文旨在区分并识别这一独立的信念维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二维信念框架（区分风险分歧与收益分歧）；投资组合需求机制（portfolio-demand mechanism）；异质信念资产定价理论
AI.method: 基于二维信念框架，利用机器学习方法构建股票层面的未来收益波动率分歧度量（DOV）；采用横截面股票收益回归、机构持股变化分析、市场层面聚合预测等实证方法。
AI.findings: （1）DOV在横截面上负向预测股票收益；（2）DOV对已有收益分歧指标具有增量预测能力；（3）高DOV股票的机构持股比例较低、后续机构持仓减少、交易活跃度降低，与投资组合需求机制一致；（4）DOV-收益负相关关系在估值不确定性更高和套利限制更严重的股票中更强；（5）股票层面DOV的加总可负向预测未来市场收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了异质风险信念作为投资者分歧的第二个独立维度，扩展了异质信念资产定价的理论框架；为风险分歧影响资产价格提供了系统的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者组合配置和市场参与决策提供参考；DOV可作为预测个股和市场收益的可操作指标，对资产管理和风险管理具有实际应用价值。

title: Do Carbon Price Forecasts Improve Compliance Procurement? Evidence from European Union Allowances
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Center for Forecasting Science; Academy of Mathematics and Systems Sciences and Central University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Do Carbon Price Forecasts Improve Compliance Procurement? Evidence from European Union Allowances
detail.abstract: Firms covered by emissions trading systems need forecasts not only to value allowances, but also to decide when to buy them. This paper asks whether European Union Allowance (EUA) prices contain short-horizon predictability that survives a forecast-origin information design and improves simulated compliance procurement. Using daily data from 2019 to 2025, we produce direct forecasts for one to five trading days ahead. All predictors are observable at the forecast origin, and calibration and model-selection rules are fixed before the final holdout. The released forecast has the lowest point-estimate RMSE at every horizon among fourteen benchmarks, with the strongest loss-difference evidence at horizons three and four. Relative to a random walk, out-of-sample R-squared rises from 1.2% at one day to 15.5% at five days. We then use the forecast path in a constrained procurement problem with execution costs, market impact, capacity limits, and tail risk; sensitivity exercises add demand uncertainty. For a fixed 100,000-EUA order, optimized schedules lower average realized costs by 8.5 to 38.5 basis points relative to uniform execution across horizons h = 2 to h = 5. The gains come from reallocating purchases within a fixed window, not from reliable next-day directional timing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟碳排放配额（EUA）价格是否存在短期可预测性，这种可预测性不仅能在统计上通过严格的预测起源信息设计检验，还能在实际的合规采购模拟中降低成本。基于2019-2025年日度数据，作者构建了1-5天预测模型，在十四种基准中均取得最低RMSE，并在约束性采购优化问题中实现了8.5至38.5个基点的平均成本节省。
AI.research_question: EUA价格是否包含能通过严格预测起源信息设计检验、并改善模拟合规采购绩效的短期可预测性？
AI.motivation: 受碳排放交易体系约束的企业不仅需要预测来给配额估值，还需要预测来决定何时购买配额。然而现有研究缺乏对EUA价格短期可预测性的严格检验，以及这种可预测性是否能转化为实际的采购成本节省的验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说与预测可检验性框架，结合预测起源信息设计（forecast-origin information design）、随机游走基准比较、以及约束性采购优化理论。
AI.method: 使用2019-2025年日度数据，构建1至5个交易日前瞻的直接预测模型；所有预测因子在预测起源时可观测，校准和模型选择规则在最终保留样本前固定；以十四种基准模型进行RMSE比较；随后将预测路径嵌入带执行成本、市场冲击、容量限制和尾部风险的约束采购优化问题中，并进行敏感性分析加入需求不确定性。
AI.findings: （1）发布的预测在每个预测期限上均获十四种基准中最低的点估计RMSE，在第3和第4期限上损失差异证据最强；（2）相对于随机游走，样本外R²从1天前的1.2%上升到5天前的15.5%；（3）在固定10万EUA订单下，优化调度相对于统一执行在h=2至h=5的期限上平均降低实际成本8.5至38.5个基点；（4）收益来源于固定窗口内购买时机的再分配，而非可靠的次日方向性择时。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次在严格的预测起源信息设计框架下检验EUA价格的短期可预测性，避免了传统研究中的前视偏差；（2）将预测绩效与实际采购决策经济后果相连接，填补了预测准确性与执行优化之间的理论鸿沟；（3）揭示了短期可预测性的边际递减特征：方向性择时（次日）不可靠但跨期限再分配（2-5天）具有经济价值。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为受ETS约束的企业提供了可操作的配额采购调度优化框架，在固定成本约束下实现实质性的采购成本节省；（2）提供了明确的预测期限依赖策略建议：企业不应依赖次日方向性择时，而应在2-5天的窗口内进行购买再分配；（3）为碳排放市场参与者的风险管理与合规成本控制提供了实证基础。

title: Greening the Bottom Line: Natural Capital’s Role in Mitigating Carbon Inequality
affiliations: University of Queensland, Beijing Institute of Petrochemical Technology, Independent, Montpellier Business School- Energy and Sustainable Development and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Greening the Bottom Line: Natural Capital’s Role in Mitigating Carbon Inequality
detail.abstract: Carbon inequality is increasingly recognized as a significant issue that requires attention to ensure an equitable and sustainable climate transition. Although previous studies have extensively examined factors such as income, consumption, and energy in determining carbon inequality, less work has examined the role of natural capital in this process. This study aims to examine the effect of natural capital on carbon inequality in Australia from 1995 to 2024, while accounting for the roles of economic globalization, financial development, economic growth, and the private sector. For this reason, the structural break unit root test, the structural break ARDL bounds test, and the dynamic ARDL simulation technique are employed to analyse the study variables’ long- and short-run properties. From our findings, there exists long-run relationship between the variables. Natural capital is negatively associated with carbon inequality, whereas economic globalization, financial development, and economic growth are positively associated with it. In contrast, private-sector activity is found to reduce carbon inequality. Additionally, our non-linear regression model suggests that natural capital and carbon inequality have an inverted-U relationship, implying that the negative effects of natural capital on carbon inequality intensify with the maturity of natural capital. On the other hand, a U-shaped relationship exists between economic globalization and carbon inequality, implying that the positive effects of economic globalization diminish as globalization increases environmental disparity. Our study makes important contributions to the literature by shifting the perspective on the roles of natural capital in promoting carbon neutrality and reducing carbon inequality. Our results indicate that restoring the ecosystem, promoting biodiversity, and adopting effective natural resource management policies would improve both carbon inequality and carbon emissions.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察1995-2024年澳大利亚自然资本对碳不平等的影响，采用结构断点单位根检验、结构断点ARDL边界检验和动态ARDL模拟技术。研究发现自然资本与碳不平等呈负相关（且呈倒U型关系），经济全球化、金融发展和经济增长与碳不平等正相关（全球化呈U型关系），私营部门活动降低碳不平等。
AI.research_question: 自然资本如何影响澳大利亚的碳不平等？经济全球化、金融发展、经济增长和私营部门在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 以往研究广泛考察了收入、消费和能源等因素对碳不平等的影响，但较少关注自然资本在其中的作用。本研究填补这一空白，从自然资本视角探讨碳不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳不平等理论、自然资本理论、经济全球化与金融发展对碳排放分布影响的相关理论。
AI.method: 采用结构断点单位根检验、结构断点ARDL边界检验、动态ARDL模拟技术以及非线性回归模型，分析1995-2024年澳大利亚的时间序列数据。
AI.findings: 1) 各变量间存在长期关系；2) 自然资本与碳不平等呈负相关，且呈倒U型关系，意味着自然资本越成熟，其降低碳不平等的作用越强；3) 经济全球化、金融发展和经济增长与碳不平等正相关；4) 经济全球化与碳不平等呈U型关系；5) 私营部门活动降低碳不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自然资本引入碳不平等的研究框架，揭示自然资本与碳不平等的非线性（倒U型）关系，拓展了碳不平等决定因素的理论视角，并阐明了经济全球化的U型效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明，恢复生态系统、促进生物多样性以及采用有效的自然资源管理政策，可同时改善碳不平等和碳排放，为澳大利亚及类似国家的气候政策和可持续发展战略提供实证依据。

title: Should Renewable Curtailment Be Treated as a Planning Risk?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Texas A&M University and Teesside University

detail.title: Should Renewable Curtailment Be Treated as a Planning Risk?
detail.abstract: Renewable curtailment is becoming increasingly common in power systems with high renewable penetration, yet it is often treated as an operational inefficiency rather than a planning risk. This paper develops a decision-dependent framework to evaluate how renewable expansion and siting decisions shape curtailment outcomes under uncertainty. The framework combines a two-stage stochastic capacity expansion model with an ex post curtailment risk assessment based on expected value and Conditional Value-at-Risk, where curtailment arises endogenously from network-constrained dispatch decisions. It evaluates three complementary risk measures: revenue loss risk, curtailment cost risk, and siting-induced curtailment risk, and employs a structured sensitivity-interaction approximation approach to enable tractable evaluation of alternative renewable portfolios. The approach is applied to the 2030 New York State power system, a renewable-rich and transmission-constrained system with persistent spatial mismatches between generation and demand. The results show that curtailment risk is highly location-dependent, with a small number of zones carrying a disproportionately large share of curtailment risk. Wind exhibits steeper and more system-wide risk escalation than solar, with larger spillovers and greater dependence on penetration level, whereas solar curtailment remains more spatially contained. The analysis further shows that curtailment is strongly tail-sensitive, meaning that adverse weather scenarios can produce much larger losses than average outcomes suggest. These tail-risk effects, particularly for wind and high-penetration cases, indicate that reliance on average curtailment alone is insufficient for evaluating renewable siting decisions and for informing transmission and flexibility planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个决策依赖的框架，将可再生能源扩建与选址决策如何塑造弃风弃光结果纳入风险评估，结合两阶段随机容量扩展模型与事后弃电风险评估，应用于2030年纽约州电力系统，发现弃电风险具有高度区位依赖性、尾部敏感性，且风电比光伏呈现更陡峭和更系统性的风险升级。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源的扩建和选址决策如何在不确定性条件下塑造弃电（curtailment）结果？弃电应如何被纳入规划风险评估而非仅视为运行低效？
AI.motivation: 高可再生能源渗透率下弃电现象日益普遍，但传统上被当作运行效率问题而非规划风险。现有方法依赖平均弃电水平，忽视了弃电的区位差异性和极端情景下的尾部风险，可能导致选址与输电规划决策失误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策依赖框架、两阶段随机容量扩展模型、事后弃电风险评估（基于期望值与条件风险价值CVaR）、三种互补风险度量（收入损失风险、弃电成本风险、选址引致弃电风险）
AI.method: 构建两阶段随机容量扩展模型，弃电由网络约束调度内生产生；结合期望值与CVaR进行事后弃电风险评估；采用结构化敏感性-交互近似方法实现替代可再生能源组合的可处理性评估；应用于2030年纽约州电力系统实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）弃电风险高度依赖于区位，少数区域承担不成比例的大量弃电风险；（2）风电比光伏呈现更陡峭且系统范围更广的风险升级，溢出效应更大且更依赖渗透率，光伏弃电则空间上更局限；（3）弃电具有强烈尾部敏感性，不利天气情景下损失远超平均值，风电和高渗透率情形尤为显著，仅依赖平均弃电不足以为选址和输电灵活性规划提供充分依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 将弃电从运行低效重新概念化为规划风险，提出决策依赖的弃电风险评估框架；引入CVaR等尾部风险度量到可再生能源选址决策；发展结构化敏感性-交互近似方法实现大规模组合评估的可处理性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可再生能源选址提供风险导向的决策工具；揭示传输受限系统中弃电风险的空间分布特征；为输电与灵活性规划提供尾部风险信息，超越平均弃电水平的局限。

title: From Division to Cohesion: A New Vision for the NFC Awards to Strengthen Political-Economic-Social Union and Common Citizenship in Pakistan
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE)

detail.title: From Division to Cohesion: A New Vision for the NFC Awards to Strengthen Political-Economic-Social Union and Common Citizenship in Pakistan
detail.abstract: This paper critiques Pakistan's current National Finance Commission (NFC) Award system and proposes a transformative vision for intergovernmental fiscal transfers. While the existing “gap-filling” approach provides some stability and predictable financing, it is criticized as a “pragmatic yet unscientific” method that uses arbitrary weights, disincentivizes provincial revenue collection, and fails to address horizontal fiscal inequities. The paper proposes a formal fiscal equalization program designed to ensure that all Pakistani citizens—including those in the provisional provinces and the capital—receive comparable public services at comparable tax burdens. The proposed system consists of two primary pillars: (a) Fiscal Capacity Equalization, which utilizes provincial GDP as a macro-indicator to bring fiscally disadvantaged provinces up to a national average per capita fiscal capacity; and (b) Fiscal Need Equalization, which employs the Demand for Public Services (DPS) approach, allocating funds based on objective demand-side indicators (e.g., school-age population for education, road kilometers for transportation) rather than supply-side costs. The paper concludes that moving to a transparent, objective, formula-based fiscal equalization system will foster an internal common market, encourage labour and capital mobility, and strengthen the political-economic-social union of Pakistan by ensuring regional fiscal equity and common citizenship.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了巴基斯坦现行国家财政委员会（NFC）拨款制度的"填补缺口"方法，并提出一个以财政能力均等化和财政需求均等化两大支柱为基础的正式财政均等化方案，旨在确保所有巴基斯坦公民获得可比公共服务和税负，促进内部共同市场与政治经济社会的统一。
AI.research_question: 如何改革巴基斯坦现行的国家财政委员会（NFC）拨款制度，设计一个更科学、客观、透明的政府间财政转移支付体系？
AI.motivation: 现行NFC"填补缺口"方法虽然提供稳定性和可预测的融资，但使用任意权重、抑制省级财政收入征收积极性、无法解决横向财政不公平问题，被称为"务实但不科学"。亟需一套正式的财政均等化方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义理论、财政均等化理论、财政能力均等化与财政需求均等化框架，以及公共服务需求（DPS）方法。
AI.method: 规范性制度设计研究。提出两大支柱：(a) 财政能力均等化，以省级GDP为宏观指标，将财政弱势省份提升至全国人均财政能力平均水平；(b) 财政需求均等化，采用公共服务需求（DPS）方法，基于客观需求侧指标（如学龄人口、公路里程）分配资金。
AI.findings: 建立透明、客观、基于公式的财政均等化体系将培育内部共同市场、促进劳动力和资本流动、通过确保区域财政公平和共同公民身份强化巴基斯坦的政治经济社会联合。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政均等化理论与巴基斯坦的NFC制度相结合，提出从"填补缺口"范式向基于需求侧指标的正式均等化范式转变的理论框架，丰富了财政联邦主义在发展中国家（特别是巴基斯坦）语境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦NFC改革提供具体可操作的两支柱制度设计方案（财政能力均等化+财政需求均等化），有助于推动财政资源分配的公平性和科学性。

title: Spillovers Across Blue Economy and Fossil Fuel Markets: A Quantile Time-Frequency Connectedness and Portfolio Perspective
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - Institute of Economic Studies, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University Rawalpindi (PMAS), affiliation not provided to SSRN and York University - Schulich School of Business

detail.title: Spillovers Across Blue Economy and Fossil Fuel Markets: A Quantile Time-Frequency Connectedness and Portfolio Perspective
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of ocean-based industries and the growing financialization of blue economy assets have heightened investor interest in their exposure to energy-market risks and financial spillovers. This study examines the return connectedness between blue economy stocks and fossil energy assets using a quantile time-frequency connectedness framework over the period from October 2011 to October 2025. The findings reveal that connectedness is highly quantile-dependent, with spillovers intensifying substantially during extreme market conditions. Blue economy assets tend to transmit shocks in the short term under extreme market regimes but increasingly act as shock absorbers over medium- and long-term horizons. Moreover, the results show that short-term spillovers account for the largest share of connectedness, highlighting the dominant role of near-term energy-market shocks in shaping blue economy asset dynamics. Fossil energy assets generally emerge as net transmitters of risk, whereas blue economy assets primarily function as receivers, indicating that energy-market disturbances remain an important source of risk for ocean-related investments. These results highlight the regime-dependent risk-management benefits of connectedness-based portfolio strategies and provide actionable insights for investors, portfolio managers, and policymakers seeking to strengthen resilience to energy-market shocks in maritime-related financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用分位数时频关联框架，考察2011年10月至2025年10月期间蓝色经济股票与化石能源资产之间的回报关联性。研究发现关联性高度依赖分位数水平，极端市场条件下溢出效应显著增强；蓝色经济资产在极端市场制度下短期内倾向于传递冲击，但在中长期则日益充当冲击吸收器；化石能源资产总体上是风险的净传递者，而蓝色经济资产主要是风险的净接收者。
AI.research_question: 蓝色经济股票与化石能源资产之间的回报关联性如何随市场条件（分位数）和时间尺度（时频）而变化？
AI.motivation: 海洋产业快速扩张和蓝色经济资产金融化程度加深，使得投资者日益关注其对能源市场风险和金融溢出效应的敞口，但目前对这一关联结构的时频分位数特征尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数时频关联框架（Quantile Time-Frequency Connectedness）
AI.method: 采用分位数时频关联（connectedness）方法，覆盖2011年10月至2025年10月，在不同分位数水平和时间频率上分析蓝色经济资产与化石能源资产之间的风险溢出方向和强度。
AI.findings: 1) 关联性高度依赖分位数，极端市场条件下溢出显著加剧；2) 蓝色经济资产在极端市场下短期传递冲击，中长期充当冲击吸收器；3) 短期溢出占关联性最大份额；4) 化石能源资产是净风险传递者，蓝色经济资产是净风险接收者。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分位数时频关联框架应用于蓝色经济与化石能源资产的风险传导研究，揭示了风险溢出随市场制度和投资期限而异的非对称特征，拓展了金融溢出效应对海洋经济领域的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和投资组合管理者提供基于关联性的制度依从型风险管理策略，帮助其在极端市场条件下优化资产配置；为政策制定者增强海洋相关金融市场对能源市场冲击的韧性提供可操作的政策参考。

title: Carbon Border Adjustment and the Design of Domestic Carbon Policy: A Structuralist Dynamic CGE Assessment for Tunisia
affiliations: Université de Poitiers

detail.title: Carbon Border Adjustment and the Design of Domestic Carbon Policy: A Structuralist Dynamic CGE Assessment for Tunisia
detail.abstract: The European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) prices the carbon embodied in imported steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers and electricity, exposing developing exporters to a selective charge on the goods they sell to the Union. Using a dynamic, structuralist computable general equilibrium model of Tunisia---an economy in which saving and foreign exchange constrain growth and investment drives capital accumulation and productivity---we ask whether the country should absorb this charge or answer it with a carbon price of its own. After correcting each sector's exposure for the share genuinely covered and its European orientation, a passively borne CBAM lowers Tunisian GDP by about $0.5$ percent by 2035. The efficient response is a domestic carbon price levied on all covered production, whatever its destination, and credited against the CBAM at the border: charged on a far larger base than exports alone and recycled into public saving, it raises GDP to about 0.3 percent above baseline. This gain reflects higher investment financed by lower household consumption, not an improvement in welfare, and the price cuts emissions only where producers can abate. The ranking of policies is robust to how strongly saving translates into investment and to the model's key elasticities.

AI.tldr: 本文使用动态结构主义可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型分析突尼斯应对欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的政策选择。研究发现，被动承受CBAM会使突尼斯2035年GDP下降约0.5%；而最优回应是征收覆盖所有受CBAM涵盖生产的国内碳价（无论产品销往何处），并允许在边境抵扣CBAM，这可使GDP高于基线约0.3%，但该增长源于投资增加和消费下降，并非福利改善。
AI.research_question: 突尼斯应被动承受欧盟CBAM的碳关税负担，还是采取本国碳定价政策来应对？哪种策略更优？
AI.motivation: 欧盟CBAM对进口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥和电力中的隐含碳定价，将对发展中国家出口商构成选择性收费。突尼斯作为储蓄和外汇双重约束的发展中经济体，需要评估应对CBAM的最优政策路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态结构主义可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型；储蓄和外汇双重约束下增长理论；投资驱动资本积累与生产率增长理论。
AI.method: 构建突尼斯的动态结构主义CGE模型，模拟两种情景：被动承受CBAM与实施国内碳价并抵扣边境CBAM，校正各行业真实受CBAM覆盖的份额及对欧出口导向程度，并进行敏感性分析检验关键弹性。
AI.findings: （1）被动承受CBAM使突尼斯2035年GDP下降约0.5%；（2）实施国内碳价并向欧盟抵扣CBAM可将GDP提升至基线以上约0.3%；（3）GDP增长由更高投资驱动，但以家庭消费下降为代价，不构成福利改善；（4）碳价仅在生产者可减排处降低排放；（5）政策排序对储蓄-投资转化强度及关键弹性具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CBAM分析纳入发展中经济体储蓄与外汇双重约束的结构主义增长框架，揭示了碳边境税应对策略在发展中经济体中不同于发达国家的宏观经济传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为突尼斯及其他发展中出口国提供应对CBAM的政策建议：实施覆盖全生产环节（而非仅出口）的国内碳价并寻求边境抵扣，优于被动承受关税；同时警示GDP增长不等于福利改善。

title: The Price of an Asset: Accounting, Framing, and the Political Economy of the $23.6 Trillion Decoupling Estimate

detail.title: The Price of an Asset: Accounting, Framing, and the Political Economy of the $23.6 Trillion Decoupling Estimate
detail.abstract: A widely reported EY-Parthenon estimate holds that reducing Western dependence on Chinese supply chains would require approximately $23.6 trillion in additional investment over twenty-five years. This paper does not dispute the magnitude of the estimate. It examines the accounting convention under which the figure is universally described-as a "cost"-and argues that this convention constitutes a category error with substantial policy consequences. The overwhelming majority of the estimated outlay funds durable capital assets (manufacturing, infrastructure, processing capacity, research facilities, and workforce formation) rather than consumed expenses; by the study's own sector breakdown, manufacturing, mining, and power and utilities alone account for nearly $13 trillion of the $23.6 trillion total. Treating capital formation as expense, rather than as investment yielding depreciable assets with multi-decade productive lives, systematically biases the estimate toward a conclusion of impossibility. The paper (i) develops the asset-versus-expense distinction and applies it to the estimate; (ii) restores the figure to scale, showing it represents roughly 1.8 percent of the three blocs' combined annual GDP; (iii) models the mechanism by which a proprietary, unverifiable number acquires the standing of consensus fact; (iv) identifies the one-sided structure of a decoupling model that prices Western adjustment while assigning Chinese adjustment a value of zero; and (v) concedes the genuine limits of the reframing-transition costs, inflationary drag, and duplicative capacity. The conclusion is not that decoupling is costless or advisable, but that the prevailing framing forecloses a debate the underlying arithmetic leaves open.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑将EY-Parthenon关于西方供应链去中国化需23.6万亿美元投资的估算视为"成本"的会计惯例，认为这构成范畴错误：大部分支出用于购置长期耐用资本资产（如制造、基础设施），而非消耗性费用。作者将其重新框定为投资而非成本，将该数字置于合理规模（约占三大经济体年GDP的1.8%），并分析这一专有且不可验证的数字如何成为共识性事实的机制，同时承认转型中的真实限制。
AI.research_question: 将23.6万亿美元的去中国化供应链调整估算描述为"成本"而非"投资"，这一会计惯例是否是范畴错误？它如何影响政策辩论和结论方向？
AI.motivation: 广泛报道的EY-Parthenon估算将西方供应链去中国化所需支出框定为"成本"，导致政策讨论系统性偏向"不可能"的结论。作者认为这不是对金额本身的质疑，而是对会计惯例的批判——将资本形成误作费用，扭曲了政策选择空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产与消耗性费用的区分（会计学）；社会建构的数字事实形成机制（知识社会学）；不对称的成本收益模型分析（经济学）
AI.method: 概念分析（资产-费用区分）、估算数字的重新校准（相对GDP规模）、数字如何成为共识事实的机制建模、对去耦模型结构不对称性的批判性分析
AI.findings: (1) 23.6万亿美元中近13万亿流向制造、采矿、电力等可折旧资本资产；(2) 该数字仅相当于三大集团年GDP总额的约1.8%；(3) 专有且不可验证的数字通过特定机制获得了共识地位；(4) 去耦模型只定价西方调整成本，却将中国调整成本设为零，结构不对称；(5) 重新框定有真实限度——转型成本、通胀拖累和重复产能仍需正视。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示会计分类惯例如何系统性影响政策结论的可能性空间；阐明"不可验证数字→共识事实"的社会建构机制；指出去耦成本模型中不对称定价的理论缺陷；论证范畴错误在重大政策决策中的实际后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重新审视去中国化成本的框架——区分投资与费用以正确评估可行性；揭示单一来源估算被当作共识事实的风险；提示在争论去耦成本时需同时考虑中国侧调整成本；为更平衡、开放的去耦政策辩论提供分析基础。

title: Uncertain Information Advantage and Price Discovery: Evidence from Data Vendor Dissemination Differences.
affiliations: INSEAD, Rice University - Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business, London Business School and

detail.title: Uncertain Information Advantage and Price Discovery: Evidence from Data Vendor Dissemination Differences.
detail.abstract: Using intra-day trading data, we examine how uncertainty about the novelty of private information affects price discovery. Examining staggered and largely unpredictable disseminations of identical analyst forecasts by IBES and FactSet, we show that uncertainty about whether investors have already received and traded on the information, causes (i) stock prices to react at both disseminations, (ii) price discovery at the second release to decline with the time since the first release, and (iii) both price discovery and trade price impact at the second release to be negatively related to prior returns when those returns suggest earlier trading on the news.

AI.tldr: 利用日内交易数据，考察关于私有信息新颖性的不确定性如何影响价格发现过程。通过分析IBES和FactSet对相同分析师预测的错峰且大体不可预测的发布，研究发现：投资者是否已收到并交易该信息的不确定性，导致（1）股价在两次发布时均产生反应，（2）第二次发布时的价格发现效率随与第一次发布的时间间隔增加而下降，（3）当先前回报表明信息已被更早交易时，第二次发布的价格发现和交易价格冲击与先前回报呈负相关。
AI.research_question: 投资者对私有信息新颖性的不确定性如何影响价格发现过程？具体而言，当同一信息被错峰发布时，投资者对信息是否已被他人获知并交易的不确定性如何影响价格反应和价格发现效率？
AI.motivation: 传统价格发现理论通常假设投资者知道信息的新颖程度，但现实中投资者面临的关键问题是"我收到的信息是否已经被别人交易过了"。这个问题直接影响投资者对信息的定价权重和信息交易策略，但此前缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称和价格发现理论，特别是关于私有信息新颖性不确定性的理论框架，结合市场微观结构理论来分析投资者对信息已交易程度的不确定感知如何影响价格反应。
AI.method: 使用日内交易数据，利用IBES和FactSet对相同分析师预测的错峰发布（staggered dissemination）这一准自然实验，采用事件研究方法分析两次发布时的价格反应、价格发现效率及交易价格冲击。
AI.findings: （1）股票价格在第一次和第二次发布时均会产生显著反应；（2）第二次发布时的价格发现效率与距第一次发布的时间间隔呈负相关；（3）当先前价格回报表明信息已被更早交易时，第二次发布的价格发现效率和交易价格冲击均与先前回报呈负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"信息新颖性不确定性"纳入价格发现理论框架，首次实证证明投资者对信息是否已被交易的不确定性本身会显著影响价格发现过程，丰富了信息不对称和价格发现的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 对交易者而言，该研究揭示了信息发布时机和信息新颖性不确定性对交易策略的影响；对市场设计者和监管者而言，有助于理解信息发布的错峰安排对市场效率的影响，为信息披露制度设计提供参考。

title: Empirical Calibration and Validation of the Livelihood System Integrated Model (LSIM): Evidence from Multi-Sector Livelihood Shocks in Sierra Leone, 2004-2025
affiliations: Bank of Sierra Leone

detail.title: Empirical Calibration and Validation of the Livelihood System Integrated Model (LSIM): Evidence from Multi-Sector Livelihood Shocks in Sierra Leone, 2004-2025
detail.abstract: This study presents the first empirical application of the Livelihood Systems Integration Model (LSIM) developed by Jackson (2026) to examine how macroeconomic and sectoral shocks are transmitted through Sierra Leone's livelihood system over the period 2004-2025. The analysis calibrates the LSIM using annual macroeconomic, sectoral and livelihood data, estimates an LSIM-aligned recursive structural vector autoregression (SVAR) to evaluate the dynamic effects of mining and inflation shocks, and examines the relationship between poverty, vulnerable employment, agricultural employment, inflation and mining rents through a welfare equation. Impulse response analysis reveals that mineral-rent shocks stimulate short-term economic growth but generate only limited improvements in employment quality, reflecting weak domestic transmission from extractive activities. Inflation emerges as the most disruptive shock, reducing growth while increasing agricultural and vulnerable employment, thereby intensifying livelihood vulnerability. Remittances provide a modest counter-cyclical buffer but are insufficient to offset persistent structural weaknesses within the labour market. Although limited poverty observations constrain welfare estimation, the findings consistently say that inflation and vulnerable employment remain important channels through which macroeconomic instability influences household welfare. Robustness diagnostics confirm the stability of the estimated recursive SVAR and indicate no evidence of residual serial correlation, strengthening confidence in the empirical results. The study demonstrates that livelihoods are best understood as an interconnected system in which macroeconomic conditions, sectoral performance and household responses continually interact. It concludes that strengthening price stability, improving mining-sector linkages, investing in agricultural transformation, expanding adaptive social protection and enhancing livelihood data systems are essential for building resilience and reducing poverty, while establishing the LSIM as a practical framework for informing development policy in Sierra Leone and comparable resource-dependent economies.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证应用Jackson（2026）提出的生计系统整合模型（LSIM），利用2004-2025年塞拉利昂的宏观经济、部门与生计数据，通过LSIM一致的递归结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型评估采矿冲击和通胀冲击的动态效应。研究发现矿产权租金冲击虽刺激短期增长但对就业质量改善有限，通胀是最具破坏性的冲击，会增加农业和脆弱就业，加剧生计脆弱性；汇款提供适度的逆周期缓冲但不足以抵消劳动力市场的结构性弱点。研究证明生计应被理解为一个相互关联的系统，并提出加强价格稳定、改善采矿部门联系、投资农业转型、扩大适应性社会保护和增强生计数据系统等政策建议。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济和部门冲击如何通过塞拉利昂的生计系统进行传导，特别是采矿和通胀冲击对就业质量、贫困和家庭福利的动态影响如何？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多将生计问题视为独立领域进行分析，缺乏将宏观经济条件、部门绩效和家庭反应视为相互关联系统的综合框架。本研究旨在首次实证检验LSIM模型，以揭示资源依赖型经济体中宏观经济冲击向生计结果传导的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Livelihood Systems Integration Model（LSIM，Jackson 2026），该模型将生计视为宏观经济条件、部门绩效和家庭响应持续互动的互联系统。
AI.method: 使用2004-2025年塞拉利昂年度宏观经济、部门和生计数据校准LSIM模型，估计LSIM一致的递归结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型；通过脉冲响应分析评估采矿和通胀冲击的动态效应；通过福利方程考察贫困、脆弱就业、农业就业、通胀和矿产权租金之间的关系；并进行稳健性诊断检验。
AI.findings: （1）矿产权租金冲击刺激短期经济增长，但对就业质量的改善有限，反映采掘活动的国内传导薄弱；（2）通胀是最具破坏性的冲击，降低增长的同时增加农业和脆弱就业，加剧生计脆弱性；（3）汇款提供适度的逆周期缓冲但不足以抵消劳动力市场的持续结构性弱点；（4）通胀和脆弱就业是宏观经济不稳定影响家庭福利的重要渠道；（5）稳健性诊断确认递归SVAR估计稳定，无残差序列相关证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对LSIM模型进行实证应用和校准，将生计系统理论从概念框架转化为可操作的经验分析工具，为理解资源依赖型经济体中宏观经济冲击向生计结果的传导机制提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为塞拉利昂及类似资源依赖型经济体提供政策建议：加强价格稳定、改善采矿部门与国内经济的联系、投资农业转型、扩大适应性社会保护以及增强生计数据系统，以建立韧性并减少贫困。

title: Evaluating the Predictive Validity of ICT's Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) Model on CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100 Futures

detail.title: Evaluating the Predictive Validity of ICT's Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) Model on CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100 Futures

declarations.funderStatement: I funded the research.

detail.abstract: To our knowledge, this paper provides the first systematic quantitative evaluation of the ICT Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) model on CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100 futures (NQ). The AMD model proposes that institutional participants structure intraday price delivery in three phases: overnight accumulation in the Asian session, a deliberate false breakout during London, and directional delivery to the opposing liquidity pool during the New York morning session. Using four years of real 15-minute OHLCV data from Databento (January 2022 to July 2026), we operationalize the AMD rules into a strict mechanical strategy and analyze the statistical properties of the resulting signal across N = 484 manipulation signal days using chi-square testing, Benjamini-Hochberg multiple comparisons correction, and regime-conditional analysis. Three principal findings emerge. First, the AMD manipulation signal fires on 44% of trading days. Second, 57% of valid signals see full target delivery before the 9:40 AM New York entry window opens, revealing a structural mismatch between the model's timing assumptions and actual price delivery. Third, within this operationalization of the AMD model, no directional information beyond the daily trend regime was observed: when the signal aligns with the trend it is correct 62–71% of the time (Cohen's h = 0.23–0.43); when it opposes the trend it is correct only 25–30% of the time (Cohen's h = 0.42–0.53). All four trending-regime cells survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Key findings are robust to variation in the manipulation breach threshold (5–20 NQ points), Asia range filter percentile, and stop buffer. The regime-dependent signal pattern constitutes a specific, testable hypothesis for follow-on research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对ICT积累-操纵-分配(AMD)模型在CME E-Mini纳斯达克100期货(NQ)上进行了系统量化评估，使用四年15分钟OHLCV数据，发现AMD操纵信号在44%交易日触发，57%有效信号在入场窗口前已达成目标，且该信号未提供超越日趋势体制的方向性信息。
AI.research_question: ICT AMD模型在CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100期货上是否具有可验证的方向性预测能力？其信号统计特性和制度条件依赖性如何？
AI.motivation: ICT AMD模型在零售交易社区广为流传，但缺乏严格的定量实证检验。本研究旨在通过系统化、可复现的方法对该模型声称的日内价格操纵结构进行首次全面评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: ICT积累-操纵-分配(AMD)模型：假设机构参与者在三个阶段构建日内价格交付——亚洲时段的隔夜积累、伦敦时段刻意假突破、纽约早盘时段向对立流动性池的方向性交付。
AI.method: 使用Databento四年(2022年1月至2026年7月)真实15分钟OHLCV数据，将AMD规则操作化为严格机械策略，对N=484个操纵信号日进行卡方检验、Benjamini-Hochberg多重比较校正和制度条件分析。稳健性检验涵盖操纵突破阈值(5-20 NQ点)、亚洲区间过滤百分位数和止损缓冲等参数。
AI.findings: (1) AMD操纵信号在44%交易日触发；(2) 57%有效信号在9:40 AM纽约入场窗口开启前已完成全目标交付，揭示模型时间假设与实际价格交付之间的结构性错配；(3) 该操作化AMD模型未观察到超越日趋势体制的方向性信息：信号与趋势一致时正确率62-71%(Cohen's h=0.23-0.43)，与趋势相悖时仅25-30%(Cohen's h=0.42-0.53)。四个趋势制度单元均通过Benjamini-Hochberg校正。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对ICT AMD模型进行系统定量评估，证明该模型的时间假设与实际价格交付存在结构性错配，并揭示信号的方向性价值主要来源于趋势制度而非模型本身的操纵标志，为后续研究提供了具体可检验的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易者和研究者提供了AMD模型在实际市场中的实证基准，表明该模型在缺少趋势过滤的情况下不可靠，并给出了制度条件依赖的信号模式，对策略设计有直接参考价值。

title: Real-Time Implementation Strategies for Frequency-Seletion Algorithms and Synthetic Radar Arrays Against B2 Bomber Threats: From Theory to Operational Deployment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Development Alternative and Jagannath University

detail.title: Real-Time Implementation Strategies for Frequency-Seletion Algorithms and Synthetic Radar Arrays Against B2 Bomber Threats: From Theory to Operational Deployment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest Statement: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: The proliferation of advanced stealth platforms, such as the Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit, necessitates an evolution in traditional air defense architectures beyond mere hardware upgrades. This paper investigates a novel dual-layered approach that first optimizes existing "normal" radars through intelligent frequency-seletion algorithms—specifically designed to identify and exploit gaps in the radar cross-section (RCS) characteristics of low-observable targets—and secondly, synthesizes a high-resolution detection network by fusing signals from distributed conventional sensors without physical retrofits. By dynamically selecting transmit frequencies based on real-time aspect-angle estimation and material absorption profiles, the proposed system maximizes return energy even against optimized stealth coatings. Furthermore, this study details the specific engineering steps required for real-life implementation, addressing latency constraints, synchronization protocols, data fusion architectures, and hardware integration challenges. The resulting architecture achieves robust detection probability while minimizing susceptibility to active electronically scanned array (AESA) jamming or internal resonance modes specific to the B-2's unique flying wing geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双层防御架构，通过智能频率选择算法优化现有常规雷达的性能，并融合分布式传感器信号构建高分辨率探测网络，在不进行硬件改造的情况下提升对B-2等隐身平台的探测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何在不进行物理硬件升级的前提下，通过智能频率选择和分布式传感器信号融合来提升传统防空雷达对先进隐身平台（如B-2轰炸机）的探测能力？
AI.motivation: 先进隐身平台（如B-2）的普及使得传统防空架构面临严峻挑战，单纯依赖硬件升级已不足以应对，需要探索软件算法和数据融合层面的创新方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 雷达截面（RCS）特性分析、频率选择算法、分布式传感器数据融合理论、低可观测目标探测理论
AI.method: 采用双层方法：第一层通过智能频率选择算法识别和利用低可观测目标的RCS间隙；第二层融合分布式常规传感器信号构建高分辨率探测网络。同时详细阐述工程实现步骤，包括延迟约束、同步协议、数据融合架构和硬件集成。
AI.findings: 提出的架构实现了稳健的探测概率，同时最小化了对AESA干扰和B-2独特飞翼几何结构内部共振模式的敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RCS间隙利用、动态频率选择和分布式传感器融合理论整合为系统化的防空探测框架，为对抗先进隐身目标提供了新的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了无需物理硬件改造即可提升防空体系反隐身能力的工程实现方案，包括具体的同步协议、数据融合架构和硬件集成指导，具有较强的可操作性和实用性。

title: Global citizenship education in southeast asia: A bibliometric analysis of research trends, collaboration networks, and knowledge gaps (2010-2025)
affiliations: Universitas Negeri Surabaya, Universitas Negeri Surabaya, Universitas Negeri Surabaya, Universitas Negeri Surabaya, Universitas Negeri Surabaya, Universitas Negeri Surabaya and Universitas Negeri Surabaya

detail.title: Global citizenship education in southeast asia: A bibliometric analysis of research trends, collaboration networks, and knowledge gaps (2010-2025)
detail.abstract: This study provides the first systematic bibliometric mapping of Global Citizenship Education (GCE) research in Southeast Asia, analyzing 764 peer-reviewed articles retrieved from the Scopus database spanning 2010 to 2025. Using Biblioshiny and VOSviewer, we conducted performance analysis and science mapping to identify publication trends, intellectual leadership, dominant themes, collaboration networks, and critical knowledge gaps. Results reveal that GCE research in Southeast Asia has grown at an annual rate of 43.27%, accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, with three distinct phases: embryonic (2010-2015), growth (2016-2019), and acceleration (2020-2025). The United States and Indonesia are the most productive countries, while Globalisation, Societies and Education leads among 388 journals. Thematic analysis reveals a predominant concentration in higher education contexts, with indigenous cultural values, local wisdom, and elementary education virtually absent from all nine keyword clusters. Country co-authorship network analysis reveals that, while individual intra-ASEAN ties such as Indonesia-Malaysia can be substantively strong, collaboration with Global North partners remains more extensive in aggregate. These findings provide researchers, educators, and policymakers with an evidence-based roadmap for advancing GCE in Southeast Asia, highlighting the urgent need for elementary-level research, integration of indigenous epistemologies, and development of regional research networks across ASEAN member states.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次对东南亚全球公民教育（GCE）研究进行了系统的文献计量学图谱分析，基于Scopus数据库2010-2025年间764篇同行评审论文，揭示了该领域的出版趋势、智力领导力、主导主题、合作网络及关键知识空白。
AI.research_question: 东南亚全球公民教育（GCE）研究的出版趋势、智力领导力、主导主题、合作网络和关键知识空白是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球公民教育在东南亚地区日益重要，但缺乏对该地区GCE研究现状的系统性文献计量分析，无法为研究者、教育者和政策制定者提供清晰的证据基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论框架，包括绩效分析（performance analysis）和科学图谱（science mapping）两大分析方法论。
AI.method: 使用Biblioshiny和VOSviewer工具，对Scopus数据库中2010-2025年间764篇同行评审文章进行绩效分析和科学图谱分析，包括主题聚类分析、国家合著网络分析等。
AI.findings: （1）GCE研究年增长率达43.27%，受新冠疫情加速，分为萌芽期（2010-2015）、增长期（2016-2019）和加速期（2020-2025）三个阶段；（2）美国和印度尼西亚是最高产国家，Globalisation, Societies and Education是389种期刊中的领头期刊；（3）主题分析显示研究集中于高等教育领域，而本土文化价值观、地方智慧和小学教育在全部九个关键词聚类中几乎缺失；（4）国家合著网络显示，虽然个别东盟内部合作（如印尼-马来西亚）实质性较强，但总体上与全球北方伙伴的合作更为广泛。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统绘制东南亚GCE研究的文献计量图谱，识别出该领域三个阶段的发展演变和关键知识空白，填补了该地区GCE研究系统性综述的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、教育者和政策制定者提供基于证据的路线图，指出亟需开展小学层次研究、整合本土认识论、发展东盟成员国区域研究网络等具体方向。

title: Research on BTC-Based Stablecoins
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Research on BTC-Based Stablecoins
detail.abstract: Starting from first principles, this paper systematically argues the theoretical selfconsistency and empirical foundation of a BTC-based, free-energy (joule)-anchored noncustodial stablecoin (J-ST). The full text merges four progressive studies into a complete research loop of "motivation → theory → design → empirics."

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理出发，系统论证了一种基于比特币（BTC）、以自由能（焦耳）为锚定的非托管型稳定币（J-ST）的理论自洽性与实证基础，形成了"动机→理论→设计→实证"的完整研究闭环。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种以BTC为基础、以自由能（焦耳）为锚定的非托管稳定币，并使其在理论上自洽且具备实证支撑？
AI.motivation: 现有稳定币（如法币抵押型或加密资产抵押型）存在中心化信任风险、锚定波动性以及与实体经济脱节等问题，需要探索一种去中心化、以物理量（自由能）为锚定的新型稳定币设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一性原理分析框架；自由能（焦耳）作为价值锚定的理论基础；非托管稳定币设计理论；比特币作为基础资产的信任与安全模型。
AI.method: 论文整合了四项渐进式研究，覆盖理论推演（第一性原理论证）、系统设计（J-ST架构）与实证检验（数据和案例验证），形成完整研究方法链。
AI.findings: J-ST稳定币在理论上具有自洽性，即以自由能（焦耳）为锚定可提供客观、不可操纵的价值基准；实证结果支持其作为非托管BTC基础稳定币的可行性与稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出以物理量（自由能/焦耳）作为稳定币价值锚定的理论框架，为稳定币定价机制提供了超越传统法币或加密资产抵押方案的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为BTC持有者提供一种非托管的、以焦耳锚定的稳定币方案，有助于降低稳定币的中心化风险，并推动稳定币与实体能源经济的连接。

title: Developing an Integrated Bureaucratic Reform Model to Improve Public Healthcare Service Quality in Indonesia: A Sequential Explanatory Mixed-Methods Study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Developing an Integrated Bureaucratic Reform Model to Improve Public Healthcare Service Quality in Indonesia: A Sequential Explanatory Mixed-Methods Study
detail.abstract: Objective: Public healthcare facilities in Indonesia continue to experience bureaucratic challenges that may affect service quality, organizational effectiveness, and healthcare worker well-being. This study examined relationships among bureaucratic barriers, organizational culture, psychological well-being, and healthcare service quality, and developed a proposed integrated bureaucratic reform framework.Methods: A sequential explanatory mixed-methods study was conducted in Indonesian healthcare facilities. The quantitative phase included 220 healthcare professionals and service users who completed structured questionnaires, which were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson's correlation, and multiple linear regression. The qualitative phase involved interviews and focus group discussions with 15 healthcare professionals, managers, and stakeholders. Thematic analysis contextualized and explained the quantitative findings.Results: Bureaucratic barriers were negatively correlated with healthcare service quality (r = −0.57, p < 0.01), organizational culture (r = −0.52, p < 0.01), and psychological well-being (r = −0.48, p < 0.01). Organizational culture and psychological well-being were positively correlated with service quality (r = 0.69 and r = 0.64; p < 0.01). Regression analysis showed that bureaucratic barriers negatively predicted service quality (β = −0.301, p < 0.001), whereas organizational culture (β = 0.392, p < 0.001) and psychological well-being (β = 0.271, p < 0.001) were positive predictors. The model explained 58% of the variance in service quality. Qualitative findings highlighted repetitive documentation, fragmented coordination, manual reporting, limited digital integration, and inadequate institutional support.Conclusion: Bureaucratic reform in Indonesian public healthcare should integrate administrative simplification, a supportive organizational culture, digital governance, workforce well-being, and balanced accountability to strengthen responsive, human-centered services.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用序贯解释性混合方法，考察了印尼公共卫生医疗机构中官僚障碍、组织文化、心理幸福感与服务质量之间的关系，并提出了综合性的官僚改革框架。量化阶段（220名参与者）显示官僚障碍与服务质量负相关，组织文化和心理幸福感正向预测服务质量；质性阶段揭示了重复文档、碎片化协调、数字整合不足等问题。
AI.research_question: 印尼公共卫生医疗机构中，官僚障碍、组织文化、心理幸福感与医疗服务质量之间存在怎样的关系？如何构建一个综合性的官僚改革框架来提升服务质量？
AI.motivation: 印尼公共卫生医疗机构持续面临官僚体系挑战，这可能影响服务质量、组织效能和医疗工作者福祉，但缺乏系统性的实证研究来揭示这些变量之间的关系并指导改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚障碍理论、组织文化理论、心理幸福感理论，以及服务质量模型
AI.method: 序贯解释性混合方法设计。量化阶段：对220名医疗专业人员和用户进行问卷调查，使用描述性统计、皮尔逊相关和多元线性回归分析；质性阶段：对15名医疗专业人员、管理者和利益相关者进行访谈和焦点小组讨论，采用主题分析。
AI.findings: 官僚障碍与服务质量和组织文化及心理幸福感均呈显著负相关；组织文化和心理幸福感与服务质量呈正相关。回归分析显示官僚障碍负向预测服务质量（β=-0.301），组织文化（β=0.392）和心理幸福感（β=0.271）为正向预测因素，模型解释了服务质量58%的方差。质性发现包括重复文档、碎片化协调、手动报告、数字整合有限和机构支持不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了官僚障碍、组织文化、心理幸福感与服务质量之间的量化关系，为官僚改革文献提供了印尼公共卫生领域的证据，并整合了多维度变量构建了综合性改革框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼公共卫生部门提出了具体的官僚改革建议，包括行政简化、支持性组织文化、数字治理、员工福祉保障和平衡问责制，以提升响应性人本化服务。

title: Optimizing Regret

detail.title: Optimizing Regret
detail.abstract: Building on the identity that expected regret equals the covariance between costs and decisions, this paper develops the complete derivative theory of the covariance regret functional. We derive the Gâteaux derivative, showing that the universal steepest-descent direction is the contrarian policy-(c-c), while ascent yields momentum. For linear policies π(c) = Ac + b, the gradient is the cost covariance matrix Σ c , with a zero Hessian implying boundary-optimal solutions such as the minimum-variance portfolio. We extend to constrained optimization, signgradient duality between regret minimization and alpha maximization, finite-sample convergence bounds paralleling Thompson Sampling, and gradient-descent algorithms requiring only input observations, with applications to portfolio tilting and LLM-based allocation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文基于"期望遗憾等于成本与决策之间的协方差"这一恒等式，系统发展了协方差遗憾泛函的完整导数理论。推导了Gâteaux导数，证明普适最速下降方向是逆势政策(c-c)，而上升产生动量效应。对于线性政策π(c)=Ac+b，梯度为成本协方差矩阵Σc，零Hessian意味着边界最优解（如最小方差组合）。研究还扩展到约束优化、遗憾最小化与alpha最大化的符号梯度对偶性、与汤普森采样平行的有限样本收敛界，以及仅需输入观测的梯度下降算法，应用于投资组合倾斜和基于LLM的配置策略。
AI.research_question: 如何建立协方差遗憾泛函的完整导数理论，并将其应用于投资组合优化和LLM驱动的资产配置策略？
AI.motivation: 遗憾最小化是决策理论的核心问题，但传统遗憾分析缺乏统一的导数框架。本文利用期望遗憾与协方差之间的恒等式，为遗憾泛函建立系统性的导数理论，从而为最优决策提供清晰的方向指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协方差遗憾泛函理论、Gâteaux导数理论、遗憾最小化与alpha最大化的对偶性、汤普森采样收敛理论。
AI.method: 数学推导为主：推导Gâteaux导数以确定最速下降方向；对线性政策解析求解梯度与Hessian；建立符号梯度对偶性；推导有限样本收敛界；设计基于梯度下降的算法框架。
AI.findings: (1) 普适最速下降方向为逆势政策(c-c)，上升为动量效应；(2) 线性政策的梯度为成本协方差矩阵，零Hessian导致边界最优解（如最小方差组合）；(3) 遗憾最小化与alpha最大化存在符号梯度对偶性；(4) 得到与汤普森采样平行的有限样本收敛界；(5) 提出仅需输入观测的梯度下降算法，适用于组合倾斜与LLM配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为协方差遗憾泛函建立完整的导数理论体系，统一了遗憾最小化与动量/逆势策略的数学表述，建立了遗憾最小化与alpha最大化的对偶关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接计算的梯度下降算法（仅需成本观测），可用于投资组合倾斜策略和基于大语言模型的资产配置决策优化。

title: Rethinking Information Asymmetry in Markets Shaped by Artificial Intelligence: Algorithmic Capability, Informational Advantage, and Market Power
affiliations: Universitas Pelita Harapan - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Rethinking Information Asymmetry in Markets Shaped by Artificial Intelligence: Algorithmic Capability, Informational Advantage, and Market Power

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This conceptual study did not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or identifiable personal information. Therefore, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence changes competition not only by increasing the volume and speed of information processing but also by altering which firms can convert data into economically actionable knowledge. Existing research explains transactional information asymmetry, organizational artificial intelligence capability, and algorithmic market power largely in separate theoretical streams. This conceptual article integrates information economics and Industrial Organization to explain how these phenomena are connected. It distinguishes algorithmic capability from Algorithmically Enhanced Information Advantage, defined as a firm's relative superiority in generating accurate, timely, granular, and actionable knowledge from data. The proposed theory identifies two informational pathways. In the equalizing pathway, accessible, interpretable, and verifiable algorithmic information reduces transactional information asymmetry. In the concentrating pathway, relative algorithmic capability produces informational advantage that changes pricing, screening, matching, personalization, and strategic adaptation. Such conduct can create competitive advantage and, when protected by structural and institutional conditions, contribute to market power. A reinforcing process may then allow market power to expand the data, capital, experimentation, talent, and complementary assets that support future algorithmic capability. Eight propositions specify the causal mechanism, its boundary conditions, and movement across firm, relational, and market levels. The article contributes a relational explanation of algorithmic informational advantage while showing why greater information availability can improve market coordination without necessarily producing informational equality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合信息经济学与产业组织理论，提出了"算法增强信息优势"的概念，解释了企业如何通过算法能力将数据转化为经济可行的知识，并区分了算法信息的两条路径（均等化路径与集中化路径），最终解释了为何信息可及性提高未必带来信息平等，反而可能导致市场权力集中。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何改变企业间的竞争格局？算法能力如何转化为信息优势，进而影响市场权力？为什么更高的信息可及性不一定带来信息平等？
AI.motivation: 现有研究分别从交易信息不对称、组织人工智能能力和算法市场权力三个相互分离的理论流解释AI竞争效应，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释这些现象之间的内在联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、产业组织理论（Industrial Organization）
AI.method: 概念性文章（Conceptual article），提出理论框架并派生八项命题
AI.findings: 提出了"算法增强信息优势"概念及两条信息路径：均等化路径（可访问、可解释、可验证的算法信息降低交易信息不对称）和集中化路径（相对算法能力产生信息优势，改变定价、筛选、匹配、个性化和战略适应等行为）。信息优势在结构性制度条件保护下可产生市场权力，并通过强化过程形成数据-能力-权力的循环反馈。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个关系性的算法信息优势解释框架，整合了信息经济学与产业组织理论，揭示了为何更高的信息可及性可以改善市场协调但未必产生信息平等。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业、监管者和政策制定者理解AI竞争动态提供了概念工具，有助于识别算法信息优势形成市场权力的机制及边界条件。

title: INRDX (Indian Nominal Rupee Index): Construction Methodology, Empirical Validation, and Applications of a Trade-Weighted Indian Rupee Benchmark
affiliations: University of Delhi

detail.title: INRDX (Indian Nominal Rupee Index): Construction Methodology, Empirical Validation, and Applications of a Trade-Weighted Indian Rupee Benchmark

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or institutional relationships that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. The INRDX framework was independently developed by the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this research as the study uses publicly available aggregate economic and financial data and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The development of the INRDX framework and preparation of this research paper were independently conducted by the author.

detail.abstract:
The Indian Rupee is commonly evaluated through bilateral exchange rates, particularly USD/INR. However, a single currency pair does not fully capture changes in the Rupee’s broader external value arising from India’s increasingly diversified international trade relationships.

This paper introduces INRDX (Indian Nominal Rupee Index), a trade-weighted benchmark designed to measure the external value of the Indian Rupee against a diversified basket of currencies representing India’s major trading partners. INRDX applies a rules-based framework incorporating trade-based currency selection, periodic weight updates, standardized treatment of managed currencies, and daily end-of-day valuation.

The paper presents the conceptual framework, construction methodology, and empirical validation of INRDX. The benchmark is evaluated to determine whether it contains information beyond USD/INR through incremental regression analysis, residual decomposition, lagged relationship analysis, and Granger causality testing.

The empirical results indicate that INRDX captures statistically significant information not contained in USD/INR alone. The findings suggest that a trade-weighted Rupee benchmark provides an additional perspective on currency valuation by incorporating movements across multiple trading-partner currencies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了INRDX（印度名义卢比指数），一个基于贸易加权的一篮子货币基准，用于更全面衡量印度卢比的外部价值。实证检验表明，INRDX捕捉到了USD/INR双边汇率所不包含的统计显著信息，为卢比估值提供了额外视角。
AI.research_question: 贸易加权卢比指数（INRDX）是否包含USD/INR双边汇率之外的信息？
AI.motivation: 单一的USD/INR双边汇率无法充分反映印度日益多元化的国际贸易关系下卢比的外部价值变化，需要构建一个更全面的贸易加权基准来度量卢比的整体外部价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易加权货币指数理论；有效汇率理论（基于国际竞争力与贸易结构的货币篮子构建）
AI.method: 构建INRDX指数（采用基于贸易的货币选择、定期权重更新、受管理货币的标准化处理、每日收盘估值）；通过增量回归分析、残差分解、滞后关系分析和Granger因果检验评估其相对于USD/INR的增量信息。
AI.findings: INRDX捕捉到了USD/INR单独所不包含的统计显著信息，表明贸易加权卢比基准通过纳入多个贸易伙伴货币的变动，为货币估值提供了额外视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了新兴市场货币有效汇率测度的理论框架，证明了贸易加权指数相对于单一双边汇率在货币估值分析中的增量信息价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、市场参与者和研究者提供了衡量印度卢比外部价值的更全面、更可靠的基准工具；其规则化构建框架可推广至其他新兴市场货币。

title: Reporting Regimes and the Measurement of Investment Performance
affiliations: University of Oxford, Saïd Business School, University of Connecticut - Department of Finance and University of Warwick

detail.title: Reporting Regimes and the Measurement of Investment Performance
detail.abstract: Performance by (largely institutional) separate account investors appears to exceed that of (largely retail) mutual fund investors by 50-80 basis points per year. This difference has been attributed to superior manager selection by institutional investors. We show instead that the apparent outperformance is entirely explained by differences in reporting regimes and investment size. The reporting differences arise from differences in what is disclosed, how it is disclosed, and the reporting standards that apply to the two investment vehicles. We analyze separate account-mutual fund twins, vehicles with the same portfolio manager, investment strategy, and near-identical holdings, to estimate the structural gap in reported performance. Roughly 70% of the observed gap reflects differences in the level and coverage of reported fees, and 30% reflects differences in reported gross performance. After adjusting for these differences, separate account investors perform on par with mutual fund investors gross of fees and only slightly below them net of fees, indicating broadly similar manager selection ability. Our findings show that differences in reporting regimes across economically similar investment vehicles can materially distort measured performance and the conclusions drawn from it.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，单独管理账户（主要是机构投资者）与共同基金（主要是散户投资者）之间50-80个基点的年化业绩差异，并非源于机构投资者更优秀的基金经理选择能力，而是完全由报告制度和投资规模的差异所解释。通过分析具有相同投资经理、相同策略和几乎相同持仓的"双胞胎"产品，作者发现约70%的业绩差距来自报告费用水平和覆盖范围的差异，30%来自报告的总业绩差异。调整后，两类投资者的经理选择能力基本相当。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者在单独管理账户中表现优于共同基金投资者50-80个基点/年的现象，究竟是因为机构投资者具有更优秀的基金经理选择能力，还是由报告制度和投资规模的系统性差异所导致？
AI.motivation: 以往文献将机构投资者的业绩优势归因于其更出色的经理筛选能力，但这种结论可能受报告制度差异的误导。作者希望在控制投资策略和持仓同质性的条件下，识别业绩差距的来源，避免基于传播的错误归因得出误导性结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合可观测性（信息披露制度差异）和规模经济效应的分析框架，比较两种投资载体在报告口径、披露内容、披露方式和适用标准上的系统性差异。
AI.method: 利用单独管理账户与共同基金的"双胞胎"配对样本（同一投资经理、相同策略、近乎相同持仓），通过结构分解方法估计报告业绩的结构性差距，分别量化费用差异和总业绩差异对业绩差距的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）观察到的50-80个基点业绩差距中，约70%来自报告费用水平及覆盖范围的差异，约30%来自报告的总业绩差异；（2）调整上述差异后，单独管理账户投资者在扣除费用前与共同基金投资者业绩持平，扣除费用后仅略低于共同基金投资者；（3）两类投资者的基金经理选择能力实质上相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 对"机构投资者经理选择能力更优"这一流行结论提出挑战，揭示了报告制度差异如何系统性地扭曲可观测业绩，为业绩评估领域提供了方法论上的重要修正。
AI.practical_contributions: 告诫投资者和监管者在跨投资载体比较业绩时应警惕报告口径差异；对机构投资者而言，其业绩优势被夸大，应理性评估自身经理选择能力；对监管机构而言，统一报告标准有助于提升业绩数据的可比性。

title: Natural Resource Potential of Sustainable Development of Agriculture of Ukraine
affiliations: National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine, Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics and University of the National Education Commission, Krakow

detail.title: Natural Resource Potential of Sustainable Development of Agriculture of Ukraine
detail.abstract: The interdependence and interconnectedness of components that make up the natural resource potential of agriculture, which define the distinct characteristics of the industry, are examined. Current trends in the utilization of land and other elements of agricultural natural resource potential of Ukraine, along with their impacts, are analyzed. Challenges related to shaping a natural resource strategy of sustainable development of agriculture in the face of climate change, degradation processes and the effects of military conflict are being investigated. The need of a transition to agroecological farming practices is substantiated and their core principles are outlined. Proposals for transforming approaches and methods to shift from resource-intensive and environmentally harmful practices to agroecologically focused agriculture, as a key factor in achieving sustainable development, are presented. This monograph is intended to scientists, educators, students of agricultural universities, professionals of ministries and agencies, as well as general readers who are committed to the protection and preservation of natural resource potential in agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了乌克兰农业自然资源潜力的组成部分及其相互依存关系，探讨了土地及其他农业资源利用的现状与趋势，研究了气候变化、土地退化及军事冲突背景下农业可持续发展的自然资源战略挑战，论证了向生态农业（agroecological）耕作方式转变的必要性，并提出了从资源密集型向生态农业导向转型的具体建议。
AI.research_question: 在气候变化、土地退化过程和军事冲突的多重挑战下，乌克兰农业如何构建自然资源战略以实现可持续发展？如何实现从资源密集型和环境有害型农业向生态农业导向型农业的转型？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰农业面临资源退化、气候变化影响以及军事冲突带来的多重压力，现有的资源密集型农业实践不可持续，亟需探索向生态农业转型的路径和策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然资源潜力理论、农业可持续发展理论、农业生态学（agroecology）理论
AI.method: 基于专著形式的综合分析，对乌克兰自然资源利用趋势进行现状分析，对挑战进行系统研究，并提出转型方案建议。
AI.findings: 农业自然资源潜力各组成部分具有高度相互依存性；乌克兰在土地利用和其他农业资源要素利用方面存在不可持续的趋势；气候变化、退化过程和军事冲突加剧了农业可持续发展的挑战；向生态农业耕作实践转型是必要的，且其核心原则已被阐明；提出了从资源密集型向生态农业导向转型的具体方法建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了农业自然资源潜力的构成要素及其相互依存关系，深化了对农业产业特征与自然资源基础之间关系的理解，构建了在多重危机（气候、退化、冲突）情境下农业可持续发展战略的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰农业提供了向生态农业转型的具体原则和方法建议；为政策制定者（部委和机构专业人士）、农业教育者、学生及关注农业资源保护的公众提供了实践指导；提出了应对气候变化及军事冲突背景下农业资源管理的策略建议。

title: An Axiomatic Revealed-demand Admissibility Mechanism for Agency 20 in the NewVistas Economy
affiliations: NewVistas Foundation and Quaid-i-Azam University

detail.title: An Axiomatic Revealed-demand Admissibility Mechanism for Agency 20 in the NewVistas Economy
detail.abstract: This paper models Agency 20 as an axiomatic revealed-demand market-admissibility mechanism: a constitutional evidence gate through which market claims must pass before any lease issuance, custody transfer, credit-line draw, consolidator closing, purchase-transfer activation, infrastructure commitment, or other capital-affecting action can proceed. The paper's central argument is that Agency 20 is neither a planning authority nor a passive market recorder. It does not set prices, allocate customers, guarantee demand, certify engineering feasibility, underwrite financial risk, or decide which steward deserves to succeed. Instead, it verifies whether claims regarding price, rent, service charges, occupancy, utilization, off-take, export income, import dependence, enterprise comparables, and localized demand are supported by real, current, comparable, non-favored, non-formula, privacy-preserving, and admissible market evidence. It derives a non-compensatory TOK20 operator in which failure in any required market-evidence predicate invalidates the claim; no strong projection, technical design, historical multiple, privileged relationship, or internal formula can compensate for defective demand evidence. The paper concludes that Agency 20 supplies a distinctive institutional bridge between decentralized market discovery and community-side capital protection. It permits markets to select while preventing speculative demand, technical elegance, administrative formulas, stale evidence, favoritism, or supplyfirst capacity from being mistaken for verified market truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"机构2.0"（Agency 2.0）作为一种公理化的显示需求市场可准入机制，它充当宪法性证据门，所有涉及资本变动的行动（租赁发放、托管转移、信贷提款、合并交割、购买转让激活、基础设施承诺等）都必须通过此门。其核心主张是：机构2.0既非规划机构，也非被动市场记录者，而是验证市场主张是否由真实、当前、可比、非偏袒、非公式、隐私保护且可准入的市场证据支撑。通过推导非补偿性TOK20算子，任何必需市场证据谓词的失败即宣告主张无效，即使有强投影、技术设计、历史倍数、特权关系或内部公式也无法弥补需求证据缺陷。
AI.research_question: 机构2.0作为市场需求验证机制的非补偿性公理化框架如何设计？它如何在去中心化市场发现与社区侧资本保护之间建立制度桥梁？
AI.motivation: 需要一个既不替代市场进行规划决策、也不被动记录市场活动的第三方制度机制，以防止投机性需求、技术优雅性、行政公式、过时证据、偏袒或供给先行能力被误认为经验证的市场真相。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公理化显示需求理论（axiomatic revealed-demand theory）；市场可准入性理论（market-admissibility）；非补偿性决策算子（non-compensatory operator）TOK20；宪法性证据门制度设计（constitutional evidence gate）。
AI.method: 公理化建模与逻辑推导：定义机构2.0的角色边界（不做规划、不记录、不定价、不分配客户、不担保需求、不认证工程可行性、不承保金融风险、不决定继承者资格）；推导非补偿性TOK20算子的证据谓词体系（价格、租金、服务费、占用率、利用率、提货量、出口收入、进口依赖、企业可比物、本地化需求）。
AI.findings: 机构2.0通过非补偿性TOK20算子运作：任一必需市场证据谓词的失败即导致主张失效，不能通过强投影、技术设计、历史倍数、特权关系或内部公式予以补偿。它为市场选择与社区资本保护之间提供了制度性桥梁，允许市场选择的同时防止投机性需求等被误认为经过验证的市场真相。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"机构2.0"这一新型制度角色的理论概念，区别于规划权威与被动市场记录者的二元框架；建立非补偿性（而非可补偿性/加权）的市场证据验证逻辑；将宪法性证据门理念引入需求验证领域，拓展了显示需求理论在制度设计中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为租赁发行、托管转移、信贷提款、合并交割、购买转让激活、基础设施承诺等资本决策提供了一致的市场证据验证标准；通过拒绝补偿性替代证据来防范投机性需求和供给先行谬误；在隐私保护前提下实现可比性、非偏袒性、非公式化的市场真实验证。

title: Mortgage Credit Expansion and Housing Purchase Prices: Evidence from Borrower-Level Administrative Data in Taiwan
affiliations: National Taiwan University - Department of Economics and Academia Sinica - Institute of Economics

detail.title: Mortgage Credit Expansion and Housing Purchase Prices: Evidence from Borrower-Level Administrative Data in Taiwan
detail.abstract: This paper studies how expanding mortgage credit affects housing purchases, exploiting Taiwan’s 2023 reform of the Youth Preferential Housing Loan program, which raised the maximum loan limit by 25%. Using matched administrative data and a difference-in-differences design, we find treated borrowers increased loan amounts by 13.4% and purchase prices by 17.9%, implying a demand elasticity of 1.34. The reform also shifted purchases toward premium urban locations and disproportionately benefited credit-constrained borrowers—women, non-college-educated individuals, and younger buyers—enabling them to obtain larger loans and purchase more expensive homes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用台湾2023年青年优惠房贷改革（最高贷款额度提高25%）作为准自然实验，基于匹配管理数据和双重差分设计，发现受政策影响的借款人贷款金额增加13.4%，购房价格上升17.9%，需求弹性为1.34。改革还促使购房向城市优质地段转移，并惠及信贷受限群体（女性、非大学学历者、年轻买家）。
AI.research_question: 扩张抵押贷款信贷如何影响住房购买行为？
AI.motivation: 理解抵押贷款供给扩张对住房市场的影响，对住房政策设计和金融稳定具有重要启示；同时检验信贷约束对购房行为的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷约束理论、住房需求弹性理论
AI.method: 准自然实验方法：利用台湾2023年青年优惠房贷改革作为政策冲击，采用匹配管理数据（matched administrative data）和双重差分设计（difference-in-differences）进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）受政策影响的借款人贷款金额增加13.4%，购房价格上升17.9%，需求弹性为1.34；（2）改革使购房行为向优质城市地段转移；（3）改革对信贷受限群体（女性、非大学学历者、年轻买家）的受益更大，使其能获得更大贷款并购买更贵的住房。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了抵押贷款信贷扩张对住房需求的因果证据，量化了住房需求对信贷的弹性（1.34），并揭示了信贷约束在不同人口群体间的异质性效应，丰富了信贷供给与住房市场关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房信贷政策的制定提供实证依据，表明提高贷款额度上限会显著推高购房价格，政策制定者需权衡信贷宽松对住房可负担性和市场稳定的影响；同时也揭示了信贷政策对不同群体的分配效应。

title: Hyperspectral Imaging Assisted with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) + Transformer Hybrid Model for Species Identification and Geographical Origin Tracing of Pulsatilla
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Hyperspectral Imaging Assisted with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) + Transformer Hybrid Model for Species Identification and Geographical Origin Tracing of Pulsatilla
detail.abstract: Pulsatilla chinensis (Bge.) Regel is a widely used Chinese medicinal herb and is prone to adulteration because of morphological similarity among congeneric species. It shows substantial quality variations across Northeast, North, and East China. This study combined hyperspectral imaging (HSI) with three feature-wavelength selection algorithms, including competitive adaptive reweighted sampling (CARS), successive projections algorithm (SPA), and uninformative variable elimination (UVE), to identify eight Pulsatilla species and trace the geographical origins of P. chinensis from three major producing areas. Six classifiers were compared, including support vector machine (SVM), multilayer perceptron (MLP), gated recurrent unit (GRU), convolutional neural network (CNN), Transformer, and a CNN + Transformer hybrid. Spectral differences among species and origins were detected in bands associated with chemical constituents. Deep learning models outperformed conventional machine learning. For species identification, the CNN + Transformer hybrid with CARS achieved the highest accuracy of 85.41%, reduced the spectral dimensionality by 65.9%, and improved the accuracy by 7.15% over the full-spectrum input. For geographical origin tracing, the same hybrid reached 88.58% accuracy using full-spectrum data. These results indicate that HSI integrated with deep learning (CNN + Transformer) enables rapid, nondestructive species identification and geographical origin tracing of Pulsatilla for quality assessment of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

AI.tldr: 本研究将高光谱成像（HSI）与三种特征波长选择算法和六种分类器相结合，实现了对八种白头翁属物种的鉴别及白头翁药材地理溯源。CNN+Transformer混合模型结合CARS算法在物种鉴别中达到85.41%准确率，在全光谱数据下实现88.58%的地理溯源准确率，为中药材质量控制提供了快速、无损的检测方法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用高光谱成像结合深度学习技术实现白头翁属物种的快速鉴别及其地理起源的准确追溯？
AI.motivation: 白头翁是广泛使用的中药材，由于同属物种形态相似而容易发生掺假/混用现象，且不同产地（东北、华北、华东）药材质量差异显著。传统鉴别方法难以满足快速、无损的检测需求，亟需一种高效可靠的技术手段用于中药材质量评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高光谱成像技术（HSI）基于不同物种和产地的化学成分差异在特定光谱波段产生可检测的反射特征，结合特征波长选择算法（CARS、SPA、UVE）和深度学习分类模型（CNN、Transformer等）实现模式识别与分类。
AI.method: 采用高光谱成像（HSI）采集八种白头翁属物种及三个主要产区白头翁的光谱数据；使用三种特征波长选择算法（CARS、SPA、UVE）进行光谱降维；比较六种分类器（SVM、MLP、GRU、CNN、Transformer、CNN+Transformer混合模型）的鉴别与溯源性能。
AI.findings: 1) 物种和产地间的光谱差异存在于与化学成分相关的波段；2) 深度学习模型整体优于传统机器学习方法；3) CNN+Transformer混合模型结合CARS在物种鉴别中达到85.41%的最高准确率，光谱维度减少65.9%，较全光谱输入准确率提升7.15%；4) 该混合模型在全光谱数据下实现88.58%的地理溯源准确率。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了CNN+Transformer混合架构在高光谱图像分析中的有效性，证明了特征波长选择算法（尤其是CARS）在提升深度学习模型性能方面的价值，拓展了深度学习方法在中药材光谱鉴定领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为白头翁药材的物种鉴定和产地溯源提供了快速、无损的检测技术方案，有助于中药材质量控制、防伪溯源和市场监管，对保障中药安全和推动中药标准化具有重要意义。

title: Pilgrimage Under Siege: The Complete Story of Thích Minh Tuệ, Part IV—The Economy of Trust: Value without Capture in the Age of Institutional Distrust
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Pilgrimage Under Siege: The Complete Story of Thích Minh Tuệ, Part IV—The Economy of Trust: Value without Capture in the Age of Institutional Distrust

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract:
Part IV of the five-part study Pilgrimage Under Siege examines the economic dimension of the Vietnamese dhutaṅga practitioner Thích Minh Tuệ, who owns no property, accepts no money, operates no organization, and monetizes nothing, yet became associated with an estimated US$117–499 million in annual distributed economic circulation (central estimate: US$280 million; purchasing-power-parity equivalent exceeding US$1 billion) across ten countries. The paper asks how value creation and value capture can diverge so completely, and what this divergence reveals about the relationship between trust, legitimacy, and institutions.

The analysis integrates four independent empirical streams that were developed separately rather than designed to validate one another: (1) a nine-layer economic-impact model of expenditure and attention generated around the pilgrimage; (2) a marked 2025 divergence between two state-affiliated charitable channels, with Vietnam Buddhist Sangha disbursements contracting by 39% while Vietnam Fatherland Front fundraising expanded substantially; (3) a Michigan State University causal machine-learning study reporting that social-media exposure to the pilgrimage increased Buddhist belief, perceived life meaning, ethical commitment, and charitable behavior, whereas comparable institutional Buddhist content showed no equivalent effect; and (4) Vietnam's approximately US$18 billion overseas remittance flow in 2025, within which the religious and charitable component remained stable despite the institutional contraction. Although constructed independently, these four streams converge on the same order of magnitude, consistent with a redistribution of charitable trust rather than a decline in generosity.

The paper interprets these findings through Buddhist economics, drawing on Thích Tuệ Sỹ's Buddhist Foundation of Economics (2020), particularly the doctrine of nutriment (āhāra), together with E. F. Schumacher's formulation of Buddhist economics as the maximization of well-being with minimum consumption. It further develops a structural comparison between two contemporary dhutaṅga practitioners: Thích Minh Tuệ, whose pilgrimage remained entirely unorganized and experienced repeated administrative restrictions after mid-2024, and Venerable Bhikkhu Paññākāra, whose institutionally organized Walk for Peace—supported by a state-licensed publication, public book tour, and established organizational infrastructure—received official recognition, international awards, and a United Nations platform during the same period. Both achieved international visibility, but through fundamentally different institutional pathways.

The paper argues that the case challenges a central assumption of institutional economics—that value creation and value capture ordinarily accrue to the same actor. Instead, the observed circulation organized itself around a visibly non-extractive center precisely because that center captured none of the value generated. Under conditions of sustained public observation, non-capture itself may function as a mechanism for generating trust, while trust increasingly operates as a form of economic capital.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察越南头陀行者Thích Minh Tuệ的经济维度——他不拥有财产、不接受金钱、不运营组织、不进行任何货币化，却与十个国家每年约2.8亿美元（购买力平价超过10亿美元）的流通经济相关联。论文通过四个独立实证流的一致收敛，论证了在持续公众监督下，非捕获本身可能成为产生信任的机制，而信任日益作为经济资本运作，挑战了制度经济学中价值创造与价值捕获通常归于同一行动者的核心假设。
AI.research_question: 价值创造与价值捕获为何能如此完全地分离？这种分离揭示了信任、合法性与制度之间怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 一个不拥有财产、不接受金钱、不运营组织、不进行任何货币化的行者，却与每年数亿美元的分布式经济流通相关联，这一极端案例对制度经济学的核心假设——价值创造与价值捕获通常归于同一行动者——构成根本性挑战，值得深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 佛教经济学（基于Thích Tuệ Sỹ的《佛教经济学基础》中的食（āhāra）理论及E. F. Schumacher的佛教经济学——以最小消费实现福祉最大化），以及与制度经济学的对话。
AI.method: 整合四个独立发展的实证流：（1）九层经济影响模型；（2）2025年两个国家附属慈善渠道的分化（越南佛教教会缩减39% vs 越南祖国阵线扩展）；（3）密歇根州立大学因果机器学习研究（社交媒体接触朝圣增加了佛教信仰、生命意义感、伦理承诺和慈善行为）；（4）越南约180亿美元海外汇款流分析。并对Thích Minh Tuệ与Bhikkhu Paññākāra两位头陀行者进行结构性比较。
AI.findings: 四个独立构建的实证流收敛于同一数量级，表明这是慈善信任的重新分配而非慷慨度的下降。非提取中心在持续公众监督下反而引发了大规模经济流通，而机构化组织路径（如Paññākāra的Walk for Peace）虽获得官方认可和国际平台，其经济效果却不具可比性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战制度经济学中价值创造与价值捕获通常归于同一行动者的核心假设，提出"非捕获本身可作为产生信任的机制"以及"信任日益作为经济资本运作"的理论命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解非营利、非组织化社会运动中信任资本的积累与经济流通提供实证参照，揭示官方认可与制度合法性并非经济流通的必要条件，对慈善、社会运动及制度设计具有启示意义。

title: Dynamic Cloud Service-Capacity Deployment with Costly Response Readiness
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) and Peking University

detail.title: Dynamic Cloud Service-Capacity Deployment with Costly Response Readiness
detail.abstract: Problem definition: AI product launches require service-capacity decisions before sufficient productspecific workload histories are available. Early service observations allow managers to update their beliefs about remaining workload. Unlike inventory, workload demand does not physically deplete service capacity, while preserving the ability to scale rapidly may require costly capacity-access and operational arrangements. We study how a firm should use evolving workload beliefs to decide how much capacity to deploy at the current review and whether to preserve future response readiness. Methodology/results: We formulate a finite-horizon dynamic program with workload beliefs, serviceable capacity, and an absorbing responsechannel state. A preservation-deployment decomposition evaluates the joint action by solving one deployment problem for each continuation side and comparing the optimized side values. The analysis identifies when the firm should preserve response readiness and how much capacity it should deploy conditional on that choice. We translate this structure into the Cold-Start Belief Actionability Policy (CBAP), which estimates the side-specific values from workload scenarios drawn from available predictive beliefs. We provide bounds on the policy's decision and lifecycle performance losses. Across the tested instances, numerical experiments and a BurstGPT-based evaluation of the decision layer show that CBAP reduces lifecycle cost relative to benchmark policies by avoiding premature capacity deployment and unnecessary readiness spending. Managerial implications: The results separate forecast informativeness from operational actionability and show that current deployment and future response readiness should be evaluated as distinct decision margins. Zero deployment can rationally represent Standby rather than Exit, while positive deployment need not imply preserving the response channel. Managers should therefore assess whether an updated workload belief supports current deployment, future response readiness, both, or neither.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI产品在缺乏足够产品特定工作负载历史数据情况下的服务容量决策问题。作者构建了一个有限时域动态规划模型，提出一种"保留-部署分解"方法，并据此开发了冷启动信念可操作性策略（CBAP），通过数值实验和BurstGPT基准评估证明该策略能降低生命周期成本。
AI.research_question: 企业应如何利用不断演化的工作负载信念来决定当前审查时部署多少容量，以及是否保留未来响应就绪能力？
AI.motivation: AI产品推出时，管理者在产品特定工作负载历史数据不足的情况下就必须做出服务容量决策。与库存不同，工作负载需求不会物理消耗服务容量，但保持快速扩展能力可能需要昂贵的容量接入和运营安排。这产生了独特的决策困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限时域动态规划（finite-horizon dynamic program），包含工作负载信念、可服务容量和吸收性响应通道状态三个核心要素。
AI.method: 提出"保留-部署分解"方法，将联合行动评估分解为每个延续侧的部署问题，通过比较优化后的侧值来决策。据此开发CBAP策略，从可用预测信念中抽取工作负载场景估计侧值，并提供决策和生命周期性能损失的边界。通过数值实验和基于BurstGPT的决策层评估进行验证。
AI.findings: CBAP相比基准策略降低了生命周期成本，避免了过早的容量部署和不必要的就绪支出。研究表明当前部署与未来响应就绪应作为不同的决策边缘来评估，零部署可理性代表"待机"而非"退出"，正部署也不必然意味着保留响应通道。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了预测信息性与运营可操作性，将当前部署和未来响应就绪概念化为两个独立的决策边缘，丰富了AI服务容量管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了CBAP策略作为决策工具，帮助其判断更新后的工作负载信念应支持当前部署、未来响应就绪、两者兼有或两者皆无，从而优化容量投资决策。

title: HERA: A Hierarchical-Compensatory Ranking Framework for Paired Benchmarking with Data-Driven Effect-Size Thresholds
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt, Goethe University Frankfurt and Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: HERA: A Hierarchical-Compensatory Ranking Framework for Paired Benchmarking with Data-Driven Effect-Size Thresholds
detail.abstract: ​Benchmarking candidates across conflicting performance metrics using small, paired datasets remains a persistent challenge. Standard approaches often neglect variance, rely exclusively on p-values, or require subjective weighting schemes. To address these limitations, we introduce the open-source toolbox HERA (Hierarchical-Compensatory, Effect-Size-Driven Ranking Algorithm), a non-parametric framework for paired data. HERA ranks candidates and resolves trade-offs of user-prioritized metrics. It integrates significance testing and effect-size assessment (Cliff's Delta, Relative Mean Difference) to provide robust estimates of stochastic dominance and practical magnitude. Bootstrap resampling and a Standard Error of the Mean (SEM)-based lower bound replace subjective parameterization with empirical, data-driven thresholds. Monte Carlo simulations and a comprehensive 19-test suite validated algorithmic correctness, demonstrating reliable convergence exceeding 99% and near-zero estimation errors across diverse distributions. Applying HERA to machine learning and large language model benchmarks exposes their severe statistical fragility. HERA provides a reproducible solution for robust method selection and optimization across data-intensive disciplines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HERA（分层补偿效应量驱动排序算法），一个用于小样本配对数据跨冲突性能指标排名的开源非参数框架。HERA整合显著性检验与效应量评估（Cliff's Delta、相对均值差），通过Bootstrap重采样和基于标准误的置信下界替代主观参数化，在蒙特卡洛模拟和19项测试套件中验证了超过99%的收敛可靠性和近零估计误差，并揭示了机器学习和大型语言模型基准测试的统计脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 如何在小规模配对数据集上，跨多个相互冲突的性能指标对候选方法进行稳健且可复现的排名？
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理小样本配对数据时，要么忽略方差、要么仅依赖p值、要么需要主观加权方案，缺乏一个能同时考虑统计显著性与效应量、且无需主观参数化的统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数统计学框架，结合Cliff's Delta效应量、相对均值差（Relative Mean Difference）、Bootstrap重采样、标准误（SEM）下界估计，以及分层补偿（Hierarchical-Compensatory）排序决策理论。
AI.method: 开发HERA算法框架：采用非参数配对数据方法，整合显著性检验与效应量评估，利用Bootstrap重采样构建经验性数据驱动阈值，通过SEM-based下界替代主观参数化；通过蒙特卡洛模拟和包含19项测试的综合套件来验证算法正确性，并应用于机器学习与大型语言模型基准测试。
AI.findings: HERA在不同分布条件下展现了超过99%的可靠收敛率和近零估计误差；将HERA应用于机器学习和大语言模型基准测试时，揭示了这些基准测试存在严重的统计脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为配对数据排名问题提供了整合效应量与显著性检验的非参数框架，以经验性数据驱动阈值替代主观参数化，弥补了现有方法忽视方差和依赖主观权重方案的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了开源的HERA工具包，为数据密集型学科（包括机器学习和大语言模型评估）提供了可复现的鲁棒方法选择与优化解决方案，帮助研究人员识别基准测试的统计问题。

title: From Footprints to Handprints? Principles for Assessing an Organisation’s Positive Impacts on Biodiversity
affiliations: University of Jyväskyla, University of Jyväskyla, , University of Jyväskyla, University of Jyväskylä, University of Oxford, University of Oxford - Department of Biology and University of Jyväskylä

detail.title: From Footprints to Handprints? Principles for Assessing an Organisation’s Positive Impacts on Biodiversity
detail.abstract: Organisations are a major driver of biodiversity loss, but may also have positive impacts on biodiversity. Limited guidance exists for how positive biodiversity impacts should be quantified, presenting a risk to organisations and biodiversity more widely. Here we introduce the ‘biodiversity handprint’ framework, enabling organisations to measure and communicate the additional positive contributions that they create for biodiversity beyond their responsibility to reduce harm. We establish ten guiding principles for assessing biodiversity handprints, building upon previous literature on environmental handprints and biodiversity offsetting. Overall, biodiversity handprints can be a useful tool for organisations to assess and report their positive impacts, albeit with large uncertainties. While biodiversity handprints may motivate and support progress towards global biodiversity goals, management of negative biodiversity impacts remains paramount.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"生物多样性手印"（biodiversity handprint）框架，使组织能够衡量和沟通其对生物多样性创造的额外积极贡献，超越了减少伤害的责任。文章建立了十项评估生物多样性手印的指导原则，基于环境手印和生物多样性补偿的已有文献。虽然生物多样性手印可以作为组织评估和报告积极影响的有用工具，但存在较大不确定性，且负面影响管理仍然至关重要。
AI.research_question: 组织如何量化并沟通其对生物多样性的积极贡献？如何建立一套超越"减少伤害"框架的、用于评估组织正面生物多样性影响的系统方法？
AI.motivation: 组织是生物多样性丧失的主要驱动因素，但也可能对生物多样性产生积极影响。然而，目前关于如何量化积极生物多样性影响的指导非常有限，这给组织和生物多样性本身都带来了风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于环境手印（environmental handprints）和生物多样性补偿（biodiversity offsetting）的相关文献，构建了生物多样性手印框架，并确立了十项评估指导原则。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与文献综述方法：通过系统梳理环境手印和生物多样性补偿领域的既有研究，提炼并建立生物多样性手印评估的十项指导原则。
AI.findings: 生物多样性手印框架可为组织评估和报告积极影响提供有用工具，但存在较大不确定性；该框架可能激励和支持实现全球生物多样性目标，但管理负面影响仍然是最重要的优先事项。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地提出"生物多样性手印"概念框架，将环境手印概念拓展至生物多样性领域，并为积极生物多样性影响的量化提供了十项指导原则，填补了该领域缺乏量化指导的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了衡量和沟通其积极生物多样性影响的具体工具和框架，有助于组织更好地进行生物多样性报告和可持续性披露，同时支持全球生物多样性目标的推进。

title: Breaking the Stalemate: Vertical Market Failure in Magnetic Data Storage
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Breaking the Stalemate: Vertical Market Failure in Magnetic Data Storage

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are principals of West Ox Advisors, an independent research and advisory firm serving the data storage industry, and this paper draws on that advisory work. Matt Klusas previously served as a hard disk drive and magnetic tape commodity manager at Amazon Web Services, and Peter Faulhaber previously served as President and Chief Executive of Fujifilm Recording Media U.S.A. The analysis and conclusions are the authors' own and were not commissioned, funded, or reviewed by any supplier, buyer, or other party in the industry.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted and funded internally by West Ox Advisors. It received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
The magnetic data storage industry, comprising hard disk drives (HDD) and magnetic tape, exhibits the structural conditions that industrial organization theory associates with systematic under-investment in breakthrough innovation.
